600: Ematay ashlim kudesha berich hu lesamael. bikrava desisra, deikker kudesha berich hu lechol innun retichin, veitmesaru bida dematronita. hada hu dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:21) nachal kishon gerafam nachal kedumim vegomer. ulezimna deate, yitmesaru kullehu, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meadom chamutz begadim mibbatzra vegomer. veal da vayyelech meacharehem, dizmina shechinta besof yomayya leakera lon min alma.

Vayyissa ammud heanan mippenehem, man ammud heanan da. ribbi yose amar, da hu anana deitchaze tadir im shechinta. veda hu anana deal moshe begavveh. ribbi abba amar, ketiv vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam, ella siua detzaddik hu, uferisu dirshimu dileh, veal da azil hay anan yomam, uchetiv (Tehillim 42:9) yomam yetzavve Adonai chasdo. umissitra dechesed ata anana da, veda chesed itkere, vaanana achara azil belelya, veitkere ammud esh.

Ribbi shimon amar, ammud heanan yomam: da avraham. veammud haesh layla: da yitzchak. vetarvavyyhu ishtechachu bishchinta, uma deamar ribbi abba, hachi hu vadday, deal yeda dehay (nusach acher divhay) darga, ishtechachu.
Vehay vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifni machane yisrael vayyelech meacharehem. vayyissa: denatil missitra dechesed, veitdevak besitra digvura, begin deha mata shaata leitlabbesha bedina.

Ta chaze, behahi shaata ishtelim sihara mikkolla, veyarta shivin uteren shemahan kaddishin, bitlat sitrin. sitra chada itlabbesha beitroy dechesed illaa, beshivin gelifin dinhiru deabba illaa, deanhir lah.
Sitra tinyayna, itlabbeshat beromche digvura, beshitin pulese denura, vaasara dilah dinchatu missitra deima illaa benimuse gelifin.
Sitra telatae, itlabbeshat bilvushe argevana, delavish malka illaa kaddisha, deikrun tiferet, deyarit bera kaddisha, beshivin itrin illain, missitra deabba veima, vehu kalil lehay sitra ulehay sitra.

(Sefer acher uteren itrin missitra deabba veema, veinnun shivin uteren shemahan.) vetanenan missitra dechesed shivin uteren sahadin. missitra digvura shivin uteren sofrin. missitra dett shivin uteren gavvnin leitpaara.
Uvehay atar, itgelif chad bechad, veistelik shema kaddisha, raza dirticha, vehacha itgelifu avahata, leitchabbera bechad, vehu shema kaddisha gelifa beatooy.
Tzerufa deatvavn illen, atvavn kadmae, reshimin kesidran beorach meshar, begin dechullehu atvavn kadmae ishtechachu bechesed, lemehach beorach meshar, besiddura mittekan.
Atvavn tinyayne, reshimin begilgula lemafrea, begin dechullehu atvavn tinyayne, mishtachchu bigvura, (sefer acher miggevura) legallaa dinin vezinin deatyayn missitra dismala.

Atvavn telitae, innun atvavn reshiman, leachazaa gavvnin, leitattera bemalka kaddisha. vecholla beh mitchabberan umitkashsheran, vehu itattar beitteroy beorach meshar, verashim lehay sitra ulehay sitra, kemalka deitattar becholla.

Hacha itreshim shema kaddisha gelifa bev tevin, demitattere baavahata, reticha kaddisha illaa. vei tema, hane atvavn telitae, may tama lav innun ketivin, minnehon beorach meshar kesidduran, uminhon lemafrea, leyashshera lehay sitra, ulehay sitra, deha tanenan, (Tehillim 99:4) atta konanta mesharim, kudesha berich hu avid mesharim litre sitre, uchetiv (shamevatekav) vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim vegomer, da kudesha berich hu. ribbi yitzchak amar, da yaakov, vecholla chad.

Ella lemalka deihu shelim mikkolla, dateh shelim mikkolla, ma archeh dehahu malka. anpoy nehirin keshimsha tadir, begin deihu shelim. vechad dain, dain letav vedain levish. veal da bae leistammera minneh. man deihu tippesha, chame anpoy demalka nehirin vechayyeychan, vela isittemar minneh. uman deihu chakkima, af al gav dechame anpoy demalka nehirin, amar malka vadday shelim hu, shelim hu mikkolla, dateh shelim, ana chame divhahu nehiru, dina yativ
601: Veitkasya, af al gav dela itchazya, dei lav hachi, la yehe malka shelim, veal da bae leistammera.

Kacha kudesha berich hu, shelim tadir behay gavvna uvehay gavvna, aval la itchazya, ella binhiru deappin. uvegin kach, innun tippeshin chayyayvin la istammeran minneh. innun chakkimin zakkain, amrin, malka shelim hu, af al gav [amru hamagihim kan matzanu katuv pasuk vayisa kaseder kol ot veot bevayit echad bimrubba im ze bae leistammera minneh.

Amar ribbi yehuda, mehacha, (Malachi 3:6) ani Adonai lo shaniti. la daligna laatar achara, bi itkelil kolla. hani tere gavvne bi itteklilan, begin kach kolla beorach meshar itchazya, veaf al gav deatvavn achidan lehay sitra ulehay sitra, kesidran ketivin.

(Shemot 14:19) vayyissa malach haelohim haholech lifne machane yisrael vayyelech meacharehem vayyissa ammud heanan mippenehem vayyaamod meacharehem. ad kan sitra chad, chesed leavraham. amar ribbi shimon, elazar beri, ta chaze raza da. kad attika kaddisha anhir lemalka, anhir leh, (sefer acher ater leh veachasin leh, bechitrin vechulei) veitterin leh, bechitrin kaddishin illain, kad matan legabbeh mitattere avahata, beshaata demitattere avahata, keden hu shelimu decholla. keden matronita, natla bematlanaha, (behahu) (nusach acher bashevaletanea behahi) shelimu daavahata. vechad mitattera mikkullehon, keden itbarcha, ureshuta decholla bidaha.

Kegavvna da shema kaddisha gelifa beatooy reshimin birticha illaa kaddisha ittura daavahan. <small>amru hamagihim kan matzanu katuv pasuk vayisa kaseder kol ot veot bevayit echad bimrubba im ze hallashon ad kan ittekanu turin kesidran beraza dechesed la satan limmina usemala. achar ken matzanu pasuk vayyavo lemafrea kmo chen kol ot veot bevayit echad bimrubba im zehi hallashon ad kan ittekanu turin lemfrea beraza digvura kulhu semola kelilan bimina. achar kach matzanu pasuk vayet kaseder kemo chen kol ot veot bevayit echad bimrubba im ze hallashon ad kan kelilan turin dishma kaddisha betiferet levatar mitchabberan avahan veitavidu shemma kaddisha. veachar kach matzanu 77 shemot hayotzim mishlsha pesukim ellu bimrubba kol shm veshem mishlsha otiyyot hayotzim mishlsha pesukim ellu yashar hafuch yashar vehasiman 25 or im ze hallashon ha kegavna da shemma kaddisha gelifa beatvoy reshimin birticha illaa kaddisha itura deavahan. velo hadepasenav oto kan mippene yekar tiferet gedullato. (Amar rabbi yesa, ashkachna beraza da batekayavetaa 0 derav hamenuna sava, telat uvechen uvechen uvechen, lokovle hane telat. vechach hu siddura. amar rabbi yose, kolla itkelil behay shemma 1 kaddisha, vaasateyym beh, ishtechach dishlimu dirticha kaddisha it beh.)

Amar ribbi shimon, hay hu shema kaddisha, ittura daavahan, demitatra begillufayyhu, bechibbura kachada. shelimu dirticha kaddisha. veitkelil bearbein utemanya tevuta, deihu shelimu decholla, veikara desharashin.

Ta chaze, gufa deilana, ani alef (Vayikra 151) nun yod. resha dechol anfe ilana, vahu. (17) veha ittearu chavrayya, kelala daanafin venofa vesharasha, bearbein utemanya tevin. veha itreshim bitlat almin illain, 11 almin tattain.

Lokovleh, kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot. kadosh leella. kadosh beemtzaita. kadosh letatta. kadosh chesed. kadosh gevura. kadosh tiferet. vechullehu beshivin uteren itgelifu, kema deittemar. berich hu, berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin amen.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, beshaata desharu yisrael al yamma, chamu lechamma
602: Ochlosin, lechamma chayyaylin, lechamma mashshiryayn, meella vetatta, vechullehu bichnufeya alayyhu deyisrael, shariu bitzllo miggo aku dilhon.

Beh shaata, chamu yisrael aku mikkol sitrin, yamma begallohi dezakfan kamayyhu. batrayyhu, kol innun ochlosin, kol innun mashshiryayn demitzrayim, leella alayyhu kamma kategorin. shariu tzavvchin lekudesha berich hu.

Keden ketiv, vayyomer Adonai el moshe ma titzak elay. vetana besifra ditzniuta, elay, (21 amud alef) dayyka, beattika talya kolla. beh shaata itgele attika kaddisha, veishtechach raava bechullehu almin illain, keden nehiru decholla, itnehir.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, keden, kad itnehir kolla kachada, veavid yamma nimmusin illain, veitmesaru bidoy illain vetattain. uvegine kach, kashya kame kudesha berich hu kolla, kikriat yam sof, vecholla hachi ukemuha. may taama. begin dikriat yam (Bereshit 260 amud alef) suf beattika talyay.

Amar ribbi shimon, chad ayyaylta it beara, vekudesha berich hu avid sagya beginah, beshaata dehi tzovachat, kudesha berich hu shama aku dilah, vekabbil kalah. vechad itzterich alma lerachame lemayyay, hi yahavat kalin, vekudesha berich hu shama kalah, ucheden chayyis al alma, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 42:2) keayyal taarog al afike mayim.

Vechad baya leolada, hi setima mikkol sitrin, keden atyay veshavviat resha ben birkaha, vetzovachat veramat kalin, vekudesha berich hu chayyis alla, (219 amud bet) vezammin lekabbelah chad nachash, venashich bearyayta dilah, ufatach lah, vekara lah hahu atar, veolidat miyyad. amar rabbi shimon behay milla, la tishal vela tenasse et Adonai, vehachi dayyka.

(Shemot 14:30) vayyosha Adonai beyom hahu et yisrael vegomer, vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met, hahu shultana memana demitzrae, achme lon kudesha berich hu, deabar leh, binhar (7 amud alef, 222 amud bet) dinur, dehava bisfata deyamma rabba. met, may taama met. kema deukemuha, deaberu leh, mehahu shultanuta dileh.

(Shemot 14:31) vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vegomer. ribbi chiyyay amar, hacha ishtelim yeda, vechullehu etzbean, veishtelim yeda, deitkelil beh bimina, dehachi taninan, kolla bimina itkelil, uvimina talya, hada hu dichtiv, yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev.

Veamar ribbi yitzchak, la ashkachna, man deatkif libbeh, legabbeh kudesha berich hu, kefaro. amar ribbi yose, sichon veog hachi namme. amar leh, lav hachi. innun legabbeh deyisrael ittekafu, aval legabbeh dekudesha berich hu, la, kema deittekaf paro rucheh lokovleh, vahava chame kol yoma gevuran dileh, vela hava tav.

Amar ribbi yehuda amar ribbi yitzchak, paro chakkim mikkol charashoy hava, uvechol innun kitrin, uvechol innun yedian, istakkal. uvechol sitra dilhon, la chama purekana dilhon yisrael, vela hava tale bechad minnayyhu. veod, deha bechullehu keshiru kishra alayyhu deyisrael, ufaro la savar deit kishra achara dimhemanuta, deihu shalit al kolla. veal da hava atkif libbeh.

Ribbi abba amar, la atkif libba defaro, ella shema da. dechad hava amar moshe, ko amar Adonai, da milla mammash, atkif libbeh, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 9:12) vaychazzek Adonai et lev paro. deha bechol chachmeta dileh, la ishtechach, dishma da shalit beara. veal da amar, mi Adonai. ulevatar amar, Adonai hatztzaddik. amar ribbi yose, levatar amar, (Shemot 10) chatati laAdonai hahu puma deamar da, amar da.

Ribbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Iyov 9:22) achat hi al ken amarti tam verasha hu mechalle. hay kera, ukemuha beraza dechachmeta. achat hi, may achat hi. hada hu dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati achat hi leimmah. uvehay, kudesha berich hu dain dinoy letatta, vedain dinoy leella becholla.
Vechad kudesha berich hu ittear dinoy, dain dinoy behay kitra, keden ketiv, tam verasha hu mechalle.
603: Begin deinnun tzaddikayyay, mittafsan bechovehon derashiayya, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 24:16) vayyomer Adonai lammalach hammashchit baam rav vegomer, veal da amar (Rabbi yose) iyyov milla da, (amar) velo agmar milla, veokmuha tol harav, ribbi yesa amar, achat hi: da keneset yisrael begaluta demitzrayim, divginah katal kudesha berich hu bemitzrae, veavid behu nukemin, hada hu dichtiv tam verasha hu mechalle.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, iyyov la alke, ella bezimna denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim. amar iyyov, i hachi, kol appayyay shavin, tam verasha hu mechalle, paro atkif behu beyisrael, veamar (Shemot Adonai:2) mi Adonai asher eshma bekolo. vaana la atkifna behu, vela avidna midi, tam verasha hu mechalle. hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 9:20) hayyare et devar Adonai meavde paro, ze iyyov.

Rabbi yehuda amar, innun avne barda, dahavo nachtin, itakkevu al yedoy demoshe, levatar avdu nukemin, beyome dihoshua. ulezimna deate, zeminin leachata innun deishtaaru, al edom uvenoteha. amar ribbi yose, hada hu dichtiv, (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot.

Davar acher vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vegomer, hay kera lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh. bekadmita vayyar yisrael, uvatar vayyiru haam et Adonai. ella amar ribbi yehuda, hahu sava denachat im benoy begaluta, vesavil aleh galuta, veail livnoy begaluta, hu mammash chama, kol innun nukemin, vechol gevuran, deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, hada hu dichtiv vayyar yisrael, yisrael mammash.
Veamar ribbi yehuda, salik kudesha berich hu lehay sava, veamar leh, kum chame benaych denafkin miggo amma takkifa. kum chame gevuran daavadit, begin benaych bemitzrayim.

Vehayeynu deamar ribbi yesa, beshaata denatle yisrael lenachta begaluta demitzrayim, dechilu veemata takkifa nafal aloy. amar leh kudesha berich hu leyaakov, amay at dachil, (Bereshit 46:3) al tira merda mitzrayma. mimma dichtiv al tira, mashma dechilu hava dachil.

Amar leh ki legoy gadol asimcha sham. amar leh, dachilna di yeshitzun banay. amar leh, anochi ered immecha mitzrayma. amar leh tu dachilna, dela azke leitkabbera beni avahatay, vela achme purekana devanay, ugevuran detavid lehu. amar leh, veanochi aalcha gam alo, aalcha leitkabbera bekivre avahatach. gam alo, lemecheme purekana divrach, ugevuran deaavid lehu.

Vehahu yoma denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, salik leh kudesha berich hu leyaakov, veamar leh, kum, chame befurekana divrach, dechamma chelin ugevuran avadit lehu, veyaakov hava taman, vechama kolla, hada hu dichtiv vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, mehacha, (Devarim 4:37) vayyotziacha befanav bechocho haggadol mimmitzrayim. may befanav. befanav da yaakov, deail lechullehu tamman. ribbi chizkiyya amar, vayyotziacha befanav, befanav: da avraham. dichtiv, (Bereshit 17:17) vayyippol avraham al panav.

Ta chaze, avraham amar, halleven mea shana yivvaled vegomer, amar leh kudesha berich hu, chayyecha, at techome kamma ochlosin, vechamma chayyaylin deyifkun mimmecha. beshaata denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, kol innun shevatin, kol innun rivvavn, salik kudesha berich hu leavraham, vechama lon, hada hu dichtiv vayyotziacha befanav. ribbi abba amar kullehu avahata izdemanu tamman bechol hahu purekana. hada hu dichtiv vayyotziacha befanav. may befanav illen avahata.

Ribbi elazar amar, vayyotziacha befanav: da yaakov. bechocho: da yitzchak. haggadol: da avraham. amar ribbi shimon, vechen beginehon daavahata, izdaman purekana tadir leyisrael, dichtiv (Vayikra 26:42) vezacharti et beriti yaakov veaf et beriti yitzchak veaf et beriti avraham ezkor vehaaretz ezkor. avahata tinach, mahu vehaaretz ezkor. ella, leachlela immehon david malka, deihu reticha baavahata
604: Vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola asher asa Adonai bemitzrayim. vechi hasheta asa, veha mikkadmat dena itavid, may et hayyad haggedola asher asa Adonai. ella, yad la ikre pachut mechamesh etzbean. haggedola: dichlilan bah chamesh etzbean acharanin, veitkerun keden gedola. vechol etzbea veetzbea, salik lechushebana rabba, vekudesha berich hu avid behu (sefer acher hasheta naysayn) nissin ugevuran, uvehay itakkeru kullehu dargin mishshilshulehon.
Mikkan olifna da, divchamesh etzbean kamay, ketiv, vaychazzek lev paro, kevan deishtelamu innun chamesh, tu la hava milla birshuteh defaro, keden ketiv vaychazzek Adonai et lev paro.

Veal da vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola vegomer, vayyaaminu baAdonai. vechi ad hasheta la heeminu baAdonai, veha ketiv (Shemot 4:31) vayyaamen haam vayyishmeu vegomer. veha chamu kol innun gevuran deavad lehu kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim. ella may vayyaaminu, hahu milla deamar vayyomer moshe el haam al tirau hityatztzevu ureu vegomer.

Rabbi yesa shail veamar, ketiv vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met, uchetiv lo tosifu lirotam od ad olam. amar ribbi yose, metin chamu lehu. amar leh, i ketiv lo tosifu lirotam chayyim, hava amena hachi. amar leh Rabbi abba yeot shailta.

Ella ta chaze, ketiv (divrei hayamim 1 16:36) min haolam vead haolam, vetanenan, olam leella, veolam letatta. olam dilella, mittamman hu sheruta leadleka butzinin. olam diltatta, tamman hu siyyuma, veitkelil mikkolla, umehay olam diltatta, mitaran gevuran letattae.

Uvehay olam, avid kudesha berich hu atin leyisrael, verachish lon nisa. vechad ittear hay olam lemebad nissin, kullehu mitzrae ishtekau beyamma, al yeda dehay olam, veitrechish lon leyisrael nisa behay olam. veal da ketiv, lo tosifu lirotam od ad olam, ad deyittear hahu olam, veyitmasserun bedinoy, vechevan deitmesaru beh lemittedan, keden ketiv vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met al sefat hayyam, hada hu dichtiv min haolam vead haolam, ad haolam dayka. keden ketiv, vayyaaminu baAdonai uvemoshe avdo.

(Shemot 15:1) az yashir moshe. Rabbi yehuda patach, (Yirmeyahu 1:Adonai) beterem etztzarcha vabbeten yedaticha vegomer. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu itree behu yattir mikkol shear ammin. umissegiut rechimuta derachim lehu, okim alayyhu nevia dikshot, veraya mehemana. veittear aleh rucha kaddisha, yattir mikkol shear nevie mehemne, veappik leh mechulakeh mammash, mimma deafrish yaakov mibbenoy lekudesha berich hu, shivta delevi, vechevan dehava levi dileh, natal leh kudesha berich hu, veatar leh bechamma itrin, umashach leh bimshach revut kaddisha dilella, ucheden appik mibbenoy, rucha kaddisha lealma, vezariz leh behemnoye kaddishe, mehemanuta rabba.

Tana, behahi shaata demata zimneh demoshe nevia mehemana leachata lealma, appik kudesha berich hu rucha kaddisha miggizra disappiru deeven tava, dehava ganiz bematan vearbein utemanya (nehorin, veitnehir aleh. vaaaterayh 367) itterin, kayyme kameh, veafkid leh bechol dileh. (nusach acher beteh) veyahav leh mea veshivin utelat maftechin. (nusach acher ganiz tamman vaaaterayh bitlat mea veshittin vechamesh itre veanhir aleh matan vearbein uttemanya nehorin vekaim kammeh veafkid leh bechol beta dileh vihav leh mea veshivin utelat maftechan. 2) veatar leh bechamesh itrin, vechol itra veitra salik veanhir beelef almin denaharin, uvutzinin dognizin beginzayyay demalka kaddisha illaa.

Keden abereh bechol butzinin (nusach acher busemin) divginta deeden, veaaleh behechaleh, veabereh bechol chayyaylin vegayyaysin dileh. keden izdazeu kullehu, patchu veamru, istalaku missacharaneh, (sitra desitrin) deha kudesha berich hu ittear rucha leshalletaa lemirgaz almin. kala nafak veamar, man hu den, dechol maftechan illen
605: Bidoy. patach kala achara veamar, kabbilu leh begavvavyychu, da hu dezammin lenachta ben beni nasha, uzemina orayyta, geniza deginzayyay, leitmassera bidoy, ulearasha almin dilella vetatta al yeda deden. beh shaata itregisho kullehu, venatlin avatreh, patchu veamru, (Tehillim 66:12) hirkavta enosh leroshenu banu baesh uvammayim.

Keden salleka hahu rucha, vekayyeyma kame malka. 40 peticha, salik veitattar beitteroy, veatereh bitlat mea veesrin vechamesh itterin, veafkid maftechoy bidoy. 300 daavahata, ateru leh bitlat itterin kaddishin, veafkidu kol maftechan demalka bideh, veafkidu leh behemnuta, mehemana deveta. 5 salleka veitattera beitteroy, vekabbilat leh min malka.

Keden, nachat hahu rucha bearbin deshatan, behahu yamma rabba, vekabbilat leh legaddela leh lemalka, vehi yahavat leh mittamman ziyyunin, lealkaa lefaro ulechol areh. uveshabbeta uvereshe yarche, salkat leh lemalka, keden ikre shemeh, beillen atvavn reshimin.

Uvehahi shaata, denafak lenachta leara, vezara delevi, ittakanu arba mea veesrin vechamesh butzinin lemalka, vearba mea veesrin vechamesh gelifin memanan, ozfuha lehahu rucha leatreh, kad nafak lealma, itnahara beanpoy, uveta itmalyay mizzivteh. beh shaata, kara aleh kudesha berich hu, beterm etztzarcha vabbeten yedaticha uveterem tetze merechem hikdashticha navi laggoyim netatticha.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, beh shaata katal (nusach acher appil) kudesha berich hu leravreva memana demitzrae, vechamu leh moshe uveni yisrael, keden amru shira. hada hu dichtiv, vayyar yisrael et mitzrayim met, az yashir moshe uvene yisrael.

(Shemot 15:1) az yashir moshe uveni yisrael vegomer. ribbi abba patach veamar, istakkalna bechol tushebchan deshabbechu lekudesha berich hu, vechullam patchu beaz. (Melachim 1 8:12) az amar shelomo. (Yehoshua 10:12) az yedabber yehoshua, (Bamidbar 21:17) az yashir yisrael. may tama.

Ella hachi tana, kol nissin vechol gevuran deitavedu lehu leyisrael, kad itnehir nehiru deattika kaddisha beitteroy, gelifin reshimin beaz, 3, 7, bad, ankiv bachashoche, venahir lechol ivar. vechad itchabbar nehiru dealef umate lezayin, man zayin, da (yeshaya la) cherev laAdonai mala dam. keden avid nissin ugevuran, begin deitchabbar 1 im 7. veda hu shirata. shirata hi dechol sitrin, veda hu az yashir.

Yashir, sar mibbae leh. ella milla da talya, veashlim lehahu zimna, veashlim lezimna deate, dizminin yisrael leshabbecha shirata da moshe uvene yisrael, mikkan olifna, detzaddikayyay kadmae, af al gav deistalaku bedargin illain dilella, veitkashsharu bekishshura ditzrora dechayye, zeminin kullehu leachayay begufa, ulemechome atyayn ugevuran deka avid kudesha berich hu leyisrael. ulememar shirata da, hada hu dichtiv az yashir moshe uvene yisrael.

Rabbi shimon amar mehacha, (Yeshayahu 11:11) yosif Adonai shenit yado liknot et shear ammo. liknot: kema deat amer, (Mishlei 8:22) Adonai kanani reshit darko. et shear ammo: illen innun tzaddikayyay dibbehon, deikrun shear, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 11:26) vayyishshaaru shene anashim bemmachane. vetanenan, let alma mitkayyeyma ella al innun deavde garmayyhu shirayim.

Vei tema, hoil veitkashsharu bitzrora dechayye, umitannege beinnuga illaa, amay yachit lon kudesha berich hu leara. puk veolif mizzimna kadmaa, dechol innun ruchin venishmatin, dahavo bedarga illaa dilella vekudesha berich hu achit lehu leara letatta. kol shekken hasheta, devae kudesha berich hu leyashshera laakima, kema deat amer (Kohelet 7:20) ki adam en tzaddik baaretz asher yaase tov velo yechota. vei tema, innun demitu beetyo denachash. afilu innun yekumun, vihon mare deeta, lemalka meshicha.

Veal da tanenan, moshe zammin lememar shirata lezimna deate. may tama. begin dichtiv, (Micha 7:15) kime tzetcha meeretz mitzrayim arennu niflaot. arennu, arecha mibbae leh. ella arennu mammash, leman dechama bekadmita, yechome leh tinyaynut, veda hu arennu, uchetiv (Tehillim 50:23) arennu beyesha elohim, vearehu bishuati.
606: Ucheden az yashir moshe uvene yisrael et hashshira hazzot laAdonai.

Shirata dematronita lekudesha berich hu. tanenan, kol bar nash deamar shirata da bechol yoma, umechavvevn bah, zache lememra lezimna deate. deha it bah alma deavar, veit bah alma deate, veit bah kishre mehemanuta, veit bah yome demalka meshicha. (nusach acher et leella kol inun vechulei) vetale alah, kol innun tushebchan acharanin, dekamre illae vetattae.

Hashshira shir ze mibbae leh. ella shirata, deka meshabbachat matronita lemalka. umoshe mittatta leella kaamar, veha ukemuha. laAdonai: begin deanhir lah malka anpaha, (nusach acher denahir anpoy malka lekabbala) Rabbi yose amar, dechol innun meshachin, dahavo nagdin, mashich malka kaddisha lekabbelah, begini kach meshabbecha leh matronita.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i hachi, amay ketiv moshe uveni yisrael, veha matronita baya leshabbecha. ella, zakkaa chulakehon demoshe veyisrael, deinnun havo yadin leshabbecha lemalka, begin matronita kedka yeot, begin dechol hahu chela ugevura dilah, yarta min malka.

Rabbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Eicha 2:19) kumi ronni ballayla lerosh ashmurot. kumi ronni: da keneset yisrael. ballayla: begaluta. Rabbi yose amar, ballayla: bezimna dehi shalta umitteara, lerosh ashmurot, berosh mibbae leh. ella lerosh, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 47:31) al rosh hammitta. veokimna, rosh hammitta, da yesod. uf hacha lerosh, da yesod, dematronita mitbarcha beh. rosh ashmurot: da hu resha, denetzach vehod.
Rabbi yose amar, da hu risha dechitre malka vesiyyuma. ribbi abba amar, lerosh ashmerot ketiv chaser, veda hu resha, rosh hammitta. vecholla bemalka kaddisha illaa ittemar, veda hu laAdonai.

Ribbi yesa amar, hashshira hazzot laAdonai, da hu nahara denafik meeden, dechol mishcha urevu nafik minneh, leadleka butzinin. umashma levatar dichtiv ashira laAdonai, da hu malka kaddisha illaa, veal da la ketiv ashira lo.

Vayyomru lemor, ledare darin, begin dela yitneshe minnayyhu lealmin. dechol man dezache lehay shirata behay alma, zache lah bealma deate, vezache leshabbecha bah beyomoy demalka meshicha, bechedvavta dekneset yisrael bekudesha berich hu. dichtiv lemor, lemor behahu zimna. lemor beara kaddisha, bezimna desharu yisrael beara. lemor begaluta. lemor befurekana dilhon deyisrael. lemor lealma deate.

Ashira laAdonai nashir mibbae leh, may ashira. ella begin dahavo meshabbechan tushabbachta dematronita. (bau leshabbecha) laAdonai: da malka kaddisha. ki gao gaa (145): desalik veitattar beitroy, leappaka birkan vechelin ugevuran, leassaka becholla. ki gao gaa: gao behay alma, gaa bealma deate. ki gao behahu zimna, gaa, begin deyitattar beitteroy bechedvavta shelemuta.

Sus verochvo rama bayyam, shuletanuta diltatta, veshuletanuta dilella daachidan behu, itmesaru behahu yamma rabba, veshultanuta rabba lemebad behu nukemin. vetanenan, la avid kudesha berich hu dina letatta, ad deyaaved beshuletanehon leella, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom veal malche haadama al haadama.

Rama bayyam, amar Rabbi yehuda, beh belelya, ittear gevura takkifa, dichtiv beh vayyolech Adonai et hayyam beruach kadim azza kol hallayla. (sefer acher deittear beh gevura takkifa) behahu zimna, baat matronita min malka, kol innun ochlosin diltatta, vechol innun shuletanin dilella, deyitmasserun bidaha. vechullehu itmesaru bidaha, lemebad behu nukemin, hada hu dichtiv sus verochvo rama bayyam. bayyam setam, leella vetatta.

(Shemot 15:2) azzi vezimrat yah. ribbi chiyyay patach veamar, (Tehillim 139:5) achor vekodem tzartani vattashet alay kappecha. kamma itzterichu bene nasha leyakara lekudesha berich hu, begin dekudesha berich hu kad bara alma,
607: Istakkal beh baadam lemehve shallit al kolla. (nusach acher lemeheve shelim becholla vaataberay du partzufin) vahava dame leillain vetattain. nachat leh bidmut yakkira, vechamu leh biryayn, keden itkenashu legabbeh, vesagidu lokovleh, veemata vedachala naflat alayyhu middachalteh, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 9:2) umoraachem vechittechem yihye al kol chayyat haaretz veal kol of hashshamayim.

Ayyleh leginteh denata, lenatreh lemeheve leh chedu al chidu, uleishtashea beh. aved leh terotztevulin mechappeyayn beavne yekar, umalachin illain chaddan kameh. levatar pakid leh al ilana chad vela kaim befikkuda demareh.

Ashkachna besifra dechanoch, dilvatar desalik leh kudesha berich hu, veachme leh kol ginzayyay demalka, illae vetattae, achme leh ilana dechayye, veilana deitpekad aleh adam, veachme leh ducheteh deadam beginta deeden. vechama, deilmale natir adam pikkuda da, yachil lekayyeyma tadira, ulemeheve tadira tamman. hu la natar pikkuda demareh, nafak bedimos veitanash.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, adam du partzufin itbere, veha okimna, (Bereshit 2:21) vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav, nesaro hakadosh baruch hu veitavidu teren, mimmizrach umimmaarav, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 139:5) achor vekedem tzartani. achor da maarav, vekedem da mizrach.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, ma avid kudesha berich hu, takkin lehahu nukeba veshachlil shefirutah al kolla, veayylah leadam, hada hu dichtiv vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela asher lakach min haadam leishsha. ta chaze, ma ketiv leella, vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav. may achat. kema deat amer (Shir HaShirim 6:9) achat hi yonati tammati achat hi leimmah. mitztzalotav: missitroy. kema deat amer, (Shemot 26:20) uletzela hammishkan.

Rabbi yehuda amar, kudesha berich hu nishmeta illaa yahav beh beadam, vechalil beh chachmeta vesachletanu, leminda kolla. mean atar yahav beh nishmeta. Rabbi yitzchak amar, meatar dishar nishmatin kaddishin ka atyayn.

Rabbi yehuda amar, mehacha. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya, man haaretz. mehahu atar demakdesha ishtechach beh. nefesh chayya, nefesh chayya setam, da nafsha deadam kadmaa decholla.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, adam hava yada chachmeta illaa, yattir mimmalache illae, vahava mistakkel becholla, veyada veishtemoda lemareh, yattir mikkol shear bene alma. batar dechav, astimu mineh mabbue dechachmeta, ma ketiv (nusach acher mamedaz dichtiv) (Bereshit 3:23) vayshallechehu Adonai elohim miggan eden laavod et haadama.

Rabbi abba amar, adam harishon middechar venukeba ishtechach, hada hu dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:26) vayyomer elohim naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu, veal da, dechar venukeba itavidu kachada, veitperashu levatar. vei tema, ha deamar haadama asher lukkach misham. hachi hu vadday, veda hi nukeba, vekudesha berich hu ishtattaf immah, veda hu dechar venukeba, vecholla hu milla chada.

Rabbi yose amar, azzi vezimrat yah, innun dichlilan da beda vela (50 amud bet) itparshan da min da ulealmin innun bachavivuta, biruta chada, demittamman ishtechachu (nusach acher itmashchu) meshichan denachalin umabbuin leistappeka kolla, ulevarcha kolla, la kedivu meme mabbuin, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 58:11) uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav veal da vayhi li lishua, divgine kach, malka kaddisha mashich veachasin letatta, veittear yemina lemebad nissin.

Ze eli veanvehu. da tzaddik, deminneh nafkin birkan beziuug. veanvihu: behahu atar dachavivuta ishtechach beh, veda hu makdesha. elohe avi vaarommenhu, moshe kaamar da, legabbe atar delevae atyayn mehahu sitra veal da (hava) shelemuta decholla hu behahu atar. (nusach acher behay kera)

Rabbi yitzchak amar, vayhi li lishua, da malka kaddisha, vehachi hu. umenalan. mikra acharina ashkachna leh, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 12:2) ki azzi vezimrat yah Adonai vayhi li lishua, mimmashma dekaamar Adonai vayhi li lishua,
608: (Shemot 15:2) azzi vezimrat yah vegomer, Rabbi chizkiyya patach veamar, behay kera dichtiv, (Mishlei 17:17) bechol et ohev harea veach letzara yivvaled. bechol et ohev harea, da kudesha berich hu, dichtiv beh (Mishlei 27:10) reacha verea avicha al taazov.

Veach letzara yivvaled, beshaata diikun lach sanach, kudesha berich hu ma amar, (Tehillim 122:8) lemaan achay vereay adabbera na shalom becha, deyisrael, ikrun achim vereim lekudesha berich hu. yivvaled mahu, vechi hasheta yivvaled. ella beshaata deakta yivvaled bealma, ach yehe lokovlach, leshezava lach mikkol innun deakin lach.

Ribbi yehuda amar, yivvaled: demalka kaddisha yittear behay oz, lenakma lach meumin, leyanka lach meima, behahu sitra, kema deat amer, azzi vezimrat yah vayhi li lishua. leitteara gevuran lokovel umin ovde kochavim umazzalot.

Rabbi yesa patach veamar, kamma it leh levar nash lerachama, leh lekudesha berich hu, deha let leh pulechana lekudesha berich hu, (ella) (kema) rechimuta. vechol man derachim leh, veavid pulechana birchimuta, kare leh lekudesha berich hu rechima. i hachi, bemay okimna hani kerae, reacha verea avicha al taazov. uchetiv (Mishlei 25:17) hokar raglecha mibbet reecha.

Ella ha ukemuha chavrayyay, hay kera (sefer acher beolot ushelamim vehay bachattaot vaashamot uchetiv vechulei) beolot ketiv. hasheta, reacha verea avicha al taazov, lemiflach leh, uleitdabbeka beh, ulemebad pikkudoy. al taazov vadday. veha deittemar hokar raglecha mibbet reecha. kelomar hokar yitzrecha, dela yirtach lokovlach, vela yishlot bach, vela taaved hirhura achara. mibbet reecha, man bet reecha. da nishmeta kaddisha, deail bah reecha veyahavah begavvach.

Veal da pulechana dekudesha berich hu, lerachama leh becholla, kema dichtiv, (dabeham 6) veahavta et Adonai elohecha. ze eli veanvehu, dechol yisrael chamu al yamma, ma dela chama yechezkel nevia, vaafillu innun ubbare devime immehon, havo chaman umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu, vechullehu havo amrin ze eli veanvehu elohe avi vaarommenhu, kema deat amer elohe avraham.

Amar ribbi yose, i hachi amay vaarommenhu, deha elohe avraham leella hu. amar leh, afillu hachi itzterich, vecholla chad milla, vaarommenhu becholla, leachlela, man deyada leyachada shema kaddisha rabba, deha hu pulchana illaa dekudesha berich hu.

Rabbi yehuda hava yativ kameh der shimon, vehu kare, ketiv (Yeshayahu 52:8) kol tzofayich nasu kol yachdav yerannenu. kol tzofayich, man innun tzofayich. ella illen innun dimtzafan, ematay yerachem kudesha berich hu, lemivne beteh. nasu kol, yisseu kol mibbae leh, may nasu kol. ella, kol bar nash devache, vearim kaleh al charban beteh dekudesha berich hu, zache lema dichtiv levatar yachdav yerannenu. vezache lemecheme leh beyishshuva bechedvavta.

Beshuv Adonai tziyyon, (amar leh) beshuv Adonai el tziyyon mibbae leh, may beshuv Adonai tziyyon ella beshuv Adonai tziyyon vadday. ta chaze, beshaata deitchariv yerushala 40 letatta, ucheneset yisrael itterachat, salik malka kaddisha letziyyon, veangid leh lokovleh, begin dichneset yisrael (Vayikra 75) itterachat. (hasheta deitgalya keneset yisrael salik leh legabbeh) (vayyetze 162 amud bet) vechad tithaddar keneset yisrael leatrah, keden yetuv malka kaddisha letziyyon leatreh, leizdavvevga chad bechad, veda hu beshuv Adonai tziyyon. ucheden zeminin yisrael lememar, ze eli veanvihu. uchetiv, ze Adonai kivvinu lo nagila venismecha bishuato, bishuato vadday.

(Shemot 15:3) Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo. ribbi abba patach (Bamidbar 21:14) al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et vahev besufa veet hannechalim arnon. kama it lan leistakkela befitgame orayyta, kama it lan leayyeyna bechol millaha, delet lach milla beorayyta, dela itremiza bishma kaddisha illaa, velet lach milla beorayyta, delet bah kamma razin, kamma taamin, kamma sharashin, kamma anafin.
609: Hacha it leistakkela, al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai, vechi sefer milchamot Adonai, an hu. ella hachi ittearu chavrayyay, kol man deaggach kerava beorayyta, zache leasgaa shelama besof milloy. kol keravin dealma, ketata vechurbana. vechol keravin deorayyta, shelama urechimuta, hada hu dichtiv al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai et vahev besufa, kelomar, ahava besufa. delet lach ahava ushelama bar mehay.

Tu kashya beatreh. al ken yeamar besefer milchamot Adonai, betorat milchamot Adonai mibbae leh, may besefer. ella raza illaa hu, atar it leh lekudesha berich hu, deikre sefer (nusach acher umispar) kema deat amer, (yeshaya la) dirshu meal sefer Adonai ukerau. dechol chelin ugevuran deavid kudesha berich hu, behahu sefer talyayn, (nusach acher umittamman nafkin

Et vahev besofah. man vahev, ella kol inun chelin, vechol inun gevuran deavid kudesha berich hu, behahu sefer talyayn.) vechad aggach kudesha berich hu keravoy, bechad atar deihu besofa dedargin, veikre vahev. kema deat amer (Mishlei 30:15) laaluka shete banot hav hav. besufa: besof dargin ishtechach. besufa: yam sof itkere, yam deihu sof lechol dargin.

Veet hannechalim arnon veim nachlayay deishtachchu veatnegidu. legabbe, mehahu atar illaa, deikre arnon. may arnon, ziuuga illaa dachavivuta, dela (50 amud bet) mitparshan lealmin, kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. uveda, mishtarshan sharashoy, veitreviu anafav, leoshata keravoy bechol atar, leoshata chelin ugevuran, uleitchazaa shuletana rabba veyakkira decholla.

Ta chaze, kad mitarin gevuran ukeravin dekudesha berich hu, kamma gardine tehirin, mitarin lechol ivar, keden shannenan rumechin, vesayyfin, umitarin gevuran, veyamma itregishat vegalgalloy sallekin venachtin, vearvin deazlin veshatan beyamma, lechol ivar mistallekin. shinnana kerava (nusach acher charba) beavni ballisteraot, mare deromchin vesayyfin, keden (Tehillim 45:6) chitztzecha shenunim (nusach acher mitarin leoshata kerevin bechol atar valeaveshatea chelin ugevuran lechol ivar keden yamma itregishat vegalgalloy sallekin vearvin deazlin veshatin nachtin vesallekin vazeapea ishtechach. keden mitarin megiche kerava beavne balesateraayn mare deromchin vesayyfin girin vekashtin kema deat amar chitztzecha shenunim) vekudesha berich hu ittakif becheloy, uleitara kerava. vavy leinun demalka kaddisha yitar alayyhu kerava. keden ketiv, Adonai ish milchama.

Umehacha, umeinnun atvavn, umehay kera, nafkin ture kerava leinun chayyayvayya, leillen mare devavu dechavu lekudesha berich hu. veatvavn itgalleyayn leinun mare keshot, veha itparshan millin veha ittemar.

Adonai ish milchama Adonai shemo. kevan dichtiv Adonai ish milchama, la yedana daAdonai shemo. ella, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 19:24) vaAdonai himtir al sedom veal amora gafrit vaesh meet Adonai min hashshamayim. vecholla behay sefer talyayn, kema deat amer (Iyov 20:27) yegallu shamayim avono veeretz mitkomama lo. (veal da)

Ta chaze, beshaata dekudesha berich hu ittear kerava bealma, illae vetattae itakkeru meatrayyhu, kema deokimna hada hu dichtiv markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam. ulezimna deate, zamin kudesha berich hu leaggacha kerava illaa vetakkifa baamamya, begin leokra shemeh, hada hu dichtiv (Zecharya 14:3) veyatza Adonai venilcham baggoyim hahem kayyom hillachamo beyom kerav uchetiv (Yechezkel 38:23) vehitgaddilti vehitkaddishti venodati vegomer. (markevot paro vechelo yara bayyam. kad ittear kudesha berich hu kerava keden ittearu dargin illain vedargin tattain diltatta ucheden markevot paro vechelo yara bayyam)

Rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 77:17) raucha mayim elohim raucha mayim yachilu vegomer, beshaata deavru yisrael yat yamma, amar kudesha berich hu lemalacha di memana al yamma, palig memach. amar leh lamma. amar leh begin devanay yaavrun begavvavch. amar leh, purekana dekitna keshot. may shena illen meillen.

Amar leh al tenay da, avadit leyamma kad barati alma. ma avid kudesha berich hu, ittear gevureta dileh, veitkematu mayya. hada hu dichtiv raucha mayim elohim raucha mayim yachilu. amar leh kudesha berich hu, ketol kol innun ochlosin, levatar armi lon levar. levatar chafe yamma alayyhu, hada hu dichtiv markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam.
Amar ribbi elazar, puk chame kamma retichin aved kudesha berich hu leella, kamma ochlosin, kamma chayyaylin, vechullehu
610: Keshirin illen beillen. (veha olifna) kullehu retichin illen leillen, dargin al dargin, umissitra dismala mitarin retichin (nusach acher dela) kaddishin shallitin. vechullehu dargin yedian leella.

Veha ittearna bivchor paro, dehu darga chad, dekatal kudesha berich hu (darga dileh nusach acher cheleh) vetavar leh meshulesheleh takkifa, (vedarga dileh) techot shuletaneh, kamma retichin vechamma chayyaylin dekuzemitin missetar semala, minnehon achidan baatar illaa deshuletanuta dilhon, uminhon achidan bemalchuta dilella. minnehon achidan batar arba karsevavn (sefer acher chevan), (nusach acher racheyyn) kema deittemar.

Vechullehu itmesaru bideh, bedina demalchuta, deikre yamma rabba, letavra lon middargehon, vechad innun ittebaru leella, kol innun diltatta ittebaru, veitavidu beyamma tattaa. hada hu dichtiv, markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam. vayyam setam.

Umivchar shalishav tubbeu veyam suf. umivchar shalishav, ha ittemar, veshalishim al kullo, kullehu dargin teren vechad. illen al illen. kegavvna illaa hachi itavidu. vechullehu itmesaru bidaha, leittabbera mishshuletanihon, illen veillen.

Ta chaze, ha ittemar dechullehu eser machan deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim, kolla hava yeda chada, dismala achlil bimina. deeser etzbean kelilan da beda, lokovel eser amiran, dekudesha berich hu itkere behu levatar. lokovleh decholla hay deyamma, takkif verav veshallita. kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 8:23) vehaacharon hichbid. hada hu dichtiv markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam vegomer. ulezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu lekattela ochlosin vekuzeturenatin vekonteyrisin vekalatyrolsin deedom hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 63:1) mi ze ba meedom chamutz begadim mibbatzra.

(Shemot 15:4) markevot paro vechelo yara vayyam. ribbi yitzchak patach, (Yirmeyahu 10:13) lekol titto hamon mayim bashshamayim vayaale nesiim mikketze haaretz berakim lammatar asa vayyotze ruach meotzrotav. ha taninan, shiva rekiin aved kudesha berich hu, uvechol rekia urekia kochavin keviin, verahatin bechol rekia urekia, uleella mikkullehu aravot.

Vechol rekia urekia behillucho matan shenin, verumeh chamesh mea shenin. uven rekia urekia, chamesh mea shenin. vehay aravot hillucho beorcheh, elef vachamesh mea shenin. ufuteye, elef vachamesh mea shenin, umizziva dileh, naharin kol innun rekiin.

Veha tanenan, leella mearavot, rakia dechayyot. parsot dechayyot kaddishin verumehon, kechullehu. leella minnehon karsulayin dechayyot kechullehu. shoke hachayyot, kechullehu. arkuvin dechayyot, kechullehu. yarchin dechayyot, kechullehu. agve dechayyot, kechullehu. vegufa dechayyot kechullehu. gadpayyhu, kechullehu. vetzavvarayhu, kechullehu. rashe hachayyot, kechullehu. may kechullehu. kokovle kullehu.

Vechal shayyfa veshayyfa divchayyot, lokovel shiva tehomin, velokovel shiva hechalin velokovel meara lirkia. velokovel merkia lirkia, veshiura dechullehu verumehon esrin vachamishsha alfin chulakin, mishshiura dekudesha berich hu, kema deokimna.
Veod rekia chad leella, min karne hachayyot, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia. millera kamma retichin, bimina usemala.

Mittechot yamma sharan kullehu nune yamma, veshatan, itkenafu bezavihon arba, nachtin bedargayyhu, vechullehu retichin ikrun bishmahan. mittechot illen, azlin veshatin innun zeirin, dargin al dargin, dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:25) ze hayyam gadol urechav yadayim sham remes veen mispar chayyot ketannot im gedolot. veha okimna mille.
Missetar semala tattaa, kuzemita sitra achara veachidan meinnun dilella, venachtu leittabbera mechela takkifa kaddisha. kema deokimna, markevot paro vechelo vegomer.
(Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. amar rabbi shimon, beshaata detzafra nahir, veayyalta kayyeyma bekiyyumah, itabberat besitraha, vealat bematan hechalin demalka. bar nash deishtaddal
611: Befalgut lelya beorayyta, beshaata deittear rucha detzafon, (sefer acher vetiuveta daayletaa) vechaivat ayyalatta leitteara bealma, ate immah lekayyeyma kodem malka, beshaata denahir tzafra (sefer acher vehahu bar nash tzali tzeloteh uleyached shemeh kaddisha kedka yeot) mashchin aleh chad chuta dechesed. (130 amud bet)

Mistakkel birkia, sharya aleh nehiru desachletanu dedata kaddisha, umitatter beh bar nash, vedachalin minneh kolla. keden hay bar nash ikre bera lekudesha berich hu, bar hechala demalka. al bechol taroy, let deyimche bideh.

Beshaata dekare lehechala demalka, aleh ketiv, (Tehillim 145:18) karov Adonai lechol korav lechol asher yikrauhu veemet. may veemet. kema deokimna, (Micha 7:20) titten emet leyaakov, deyada leyachada shema kaddisha bitzloteh (nusach acher bealma) kedka yeot. veda pulechana demalka (nusach acher dishma) kaddisha.

Uman deyada leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeot, okim uma yechida bealma, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 7:23) umi cheammecha yisrael goy echad baaretz. veal da okimna, kol kohen dela yada leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeot, lav pulechanih pulechana. deha kolla beh talya, pulechana illaa, ufulechana tattaa. uvae lechavvevna libba ureuta, begin deyitbarchun illae vetattae.

Ketiv (Yeshayahu 1:12) ki tavou leraot panay. kol bar nash deate leyachada shema kaddisha, vela itkavavn beh belibba ureuta udechilu, begin deyitbarchun beh illae vetattae, raman leh tzeloteh levar, vecholla machrize aleh levish. vekudesha berich hu kare aleh ki tavou leraot panay.

Ki tavou lirot mibbae leh, may leraot panay. ella kol innun anpin demalka, temirin beimka (nusach acher baatar) levatar chashocha (sefer acher yashet choshech setaro vechol vechulei) vechol innun deyadin leyachada shema kaddisha kedka yeot mitvakin kol innun kotale chashocha, veanpin demalka itchazyayn, venaharin lecholla. vechad innun itchazyayn venaharin, mitbarchin kolla illain vetattain. keden birkan ishtechachu bechullehu almin, ucheden ketiv leraot panay.

Mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem, may ka mayyre. ella man deate leyachada shema kaddisha illaa, bae leyachada missitra dezot. kema dichtiv, (Vayikra 16:3) bezot yavo aharon el hakkodesh. begin deyizdavvevgun kachada, innun teren: tzaddik vetzedek, beziuuga chada. begin deyitbarchun kolla minnayyhu veillen ikrun chatzerecha, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 65:5) ashre tivchar utekarev yishkon chatzerecha.

Vei ihu ate leyachada shema kaddisha, vela yitkavvavn beh biruta delibba, bidchilu urechimu. kudesha berich hu amar, mi vikkesh zot miyyedchem remos chatzeray. zot vadday, deha lo ishtechach behu birkan. vela day dela ishtechachu behu birkan, ella desharya behu dina veishtechach dina becholla.

Ta chaze, yemina dekudesha berich hu, minneh mitarin kol nehiru, kol birkan, vechol chidu. beh kalil semala kema deit bevar nash yemina usemala, usemala itkelil bimina, vimina hu kalil kolla. vechad ittear yemina semala ittear immeh, deha beh achid veitkelil.

Veta chaze, beshaata dearim bar nash yedeh bitzlota, mechavvevn beetzbean dileh leella. kema dichtiv, (Shemot 17:11) vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael. deha (87 amud alef) bimina talya kolla. uchetiv (Vayikra 9:22) vayissa aharon et yadav, uchetiv chaser. ucheden itkevavn levarcha leella.

Vekudesha berich hu lav hachi, beshaata dearim yemina leella, vavy lehu letattae, deha kol siyyayta vechol birkan istaliku minnayyhu. menalan. dichtiv natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. may natita yemincha. ketargumo, arimat yemincha. miyyad tivlaemo aretz. vechad yemina ishtechach, semala ishtechach immeh, ucheden la shaltin dinin bealma, may tama, begin dimina ishtechach immeh. vei yemina istallakat, ha semala izdammenat, keden dinin mitarin bealma, vedina sharya becholla.

Rabbi shimon kad hava mate lehay kera, hava bache, dichtiv, (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino. vechi efshar deheshiv achor yemino. ella begin deakdim semala lenachta bealma, vimina ishtaarat baatar achara.
Amar rabbi shimon, ketiv (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzaddik avad. veha okimna mille, hatztzaddik neevad la
612: Ketiv, ella hatztzaddik avad. mikkol innun anpe malka, la ishtechach deavad, ella tzaddik. avad bitre sitre: chad, dela sharan beh birkan, kad bekadmita. vechad, deitrechikat minneh bat zugeh dehi keneset yisrael. ishtechach, detzaddik avad yattir mikkolla. ulezimna deate ketiv, (Zecharya 9:9) gili meod bat tziyyon harii bat yerushala 40 hinne malkech yavo lach tzaddik venosha hu. tzaddik umoshia la ketiv, ella tzaddik venosha hu. hu nosha vadday. veha ittemar.

(Shemot 15:6) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach. may nedari, nedar mibbae leh. ella, beshaata dismala atya leizdavvevga bimina, keden ketiv nedari (sefer acher bechoach, tere, uleolam vechulei) tiratz, uleolam hachi hu begin dismala ishtechach bimina, veitkelil beh.

Amar ribbi shimon, kema deokimna hachi hu, devar nash ishtechach deitpelag. may tama. begin lekabbela immeh bat zugeh, deyitavidu chad gufa mammash. kad yemincha, ishtechach deitpelag. may tama. begin lekabbela immeh semala. vehachi hu kolla, chad bechad. veal da, bechad mache umasse, hada hu dichtiv yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev.

Ta chaze, shirata da ittemar, al hahu zimna, veal zimna deate, beyome deyittear malka meshicha, dichtiv, yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev, raatzt la ketiv, ella tiratz. ma ketiv bekadmita, (Eicha 1:13) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev, behahu zimna, hi tiratz oyev lezimna deate.

Vecholla hachi hu, taharos kamecha, harasta la ketiv, ella taharos. teshallach charoncha yochlemo kakkash, kolla lezimna deate. yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach, bezimna da, bealma den. yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev, bezimna demalka meshicha. uverov geoncha taharos kamecha, leviat gog umagog. teshallach charoncha yochlemo kakkash, litchiyyayt hammetim. dichtiv, (Daniel 12:2) verabbim miyshene admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot ulediron olam.

Behahu zimna, amar ribbi shimon, zakkain innun deyishtaarun bealma, uman innun. ta chaze, la yishtear mibbeni alma, bar innun gezirin, dekabbilu at kayyayma kaddisha, vealu bekayyeyma kaddisha, beinnun teren chulakin, kema deokimna. vehu natir leh lehahu kayyaym, vela ayyleh beatar dela itzterich, illen innun deyishtaarun, veyikkatvun lechayye alma.

Menalan. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 4:3) vehaya hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushala 40 kadosh yeamer lo kol hakkatuv lechayyim biyrushala 40. mashma hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushala 40, dechol man deitgezar, beillen teren dargin al. vei natir lehahu kayyaym kadka chaze, veyizdehar beh, aleh ketiv hannishar betziyyon vehannotar biyrushala 40. illen yishtaarun behahu zimna, vavohu zammin kudesha berich hu lechadta alma, ulemechode behu. al hahu zimna ketiv, (Tehillim 104:31) yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav.

Rabbi chiyyay hava azil legabbe ribbi elazar, ashkacheh, dehava yativ legabbeh deribbi yose berabbi shimon ben lakuneyay chamuy. ad dezakif resheh, chama leh leribbi chiyyay, amar, (Yeshayahu 19:24-25) bayyom hahu yihye yisrael shelishiyya lemitzrayim uleashshur beracha bekerev haaretz asher beracho Adonai tzevaot lemor baruch ammi mitzrayim umaase yaday ashshur venachalati yisrael, vechi ashshur umitzrayim kerivin innun lekudesha berich hu?

Ella, al galuta deyiskun mimmitzrayim umeashshur ittemar, vei ittemar al mitzrayim veal ashshur, al innun chasidin dilhon, deahadru betiyyuveta, veishtaarun lemiflach leyisrael ulemalka meshicha, dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:11) veyishtachavu lo kol melachim. uchetiv, (Yeshayahu 49:23) vehayu melachim omnayich vegomer.

Amar leh, may dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:17) deracheh darche noam amar leh kamma tippeshin kulei bene alma, dela yadin vela mashgichin bemilloy deorayyta, deha millin deorayyta (nusach acher kema razin illain it behu) innun archa lemizke behahu noam Adonai dichtiv deracheh darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom. darche noam vadday. may noam. kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai, veha ukemuha, begin (nusach acher kach) deorayyta, vearchoy, mehahu noam atyayn, veinnun archin perishan beh, veal da deracheh darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom.
Amar ribbi chiyyay, taninan, beshaata dekudesha berich hu yahav orayyta leyisrael, nafak nehora mehahu noam, veitattar beh kudesha berich hu, umehahu noam avhiku zivavn dechullehu almin
613: Dechullehu rekiin, dechullehu kitrin. al hahi shaata ketiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:11) tzeena ureena benot tziyyon bammelech shelomo vegomer.

Vehahi shaata deitbene makdesha, itattar kudesha berich hu behahu attara, veyativ bechurseyay dileh, veitattar baatroy. umehahu zimna deitcharav be makdesha, la itattar kudesha berich hu baatroy, vehahu noam ittammar veitgeniz.

Amar ribbi elazar, beshaata deal moshe bego anana, kema dichtiv, (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan, kevar nash dehava azil baatar derucha. ira beh chad (Vayikra 78 amud bet) malacha ravreva, vetana, kemuel shemeh. vehu memana al teresar alfin memanan shelichan. baa leizdavvevga beh bemoshe, patach moshe pumeh, (Bereshit 16 amud alef) bitresar atvavn gelifan dishma kaddisha deolif leh kudesha berich hu bassene, veitrechak minneh teresar alfin parsin, vahava azal moshe baanana, veenoy melahatan kegumerin deeshsha.

Ad deiara beh chad malacha, ravreva veyakkira min kadmaa, vetana hadarniel shemeh, vehu illaa al shear malachin, elef veshittin ribbo parsin, vekaleh azil bematan elef rekiin, demistacharan beeshsha chivvavra. kevan dechama leh moshe, la yachil lemallela. baa lemishde garmeh miggo anana.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe, vechi ant hu deasgit millin immi bassene, devait leminda raza dishma kaddisha, vela dachalt. vehasheta at dachil mechad mishshammashay. kevan dishma moshe kaleh dekudesha berich hu, ittakkaf. patach pumeh, bev atvavn dishma illaa, kevan dishma hadarniel atvavn dishma kaddisha, mippumeh demoshe, izdaza. kariv legabbeh, amar leh, zakkaa chulakach moshe, deitgele lach, ma dela itgele lemalache illae.

Vahava azil immeh, ad dematu leeshsha takkifa, dechad malacha di shemeh sandalfon. vetana, sandalfon illaa hu al shear chavroy, chamesh mea shenin. vehu kaim batar pargoda demareh, vekasher leh kitrin, mibbautehon (Bereshit 167 amud bet) ditzlota deyisrael. uveshaata demate hay keter leresheh demalka kaddisha, hu mekabbel tzelotehon deyisrael. vechullehu chayyaylin veuchlosin mizdazein, venahamin veamrin, berich yekara daAdonai meatar bet shechinteh.

Amar leh hadarniel lemoshe, moshe, let ana yachil limhach immach, dela yokid li essa takkifa desandalfon. beh shaata izdaza moshe, ad deatkif beh kudesha berich hu bemoshe, veotveh kameh, veolif leh orayyta. vechafa leh lemoshe, behahu nehora veziva dehahu noam, vahavu anpoy demoshe nehirin bechol innun rekiin. vechol chela dishmayya havo mizdazein kameh, beshaata dehava nachit beorayyta.

Kevan dechavu yisrael letatta, natal kudesha berich hu (nusach acher mimmoshe) alef chulakin mehahu ziva. beh shaata, bau malachin illain, vechol innun ochlosin, leokda lemoshe, beshaata deamar leh kudesha berich hu (Shemot 32:7) lech red ki shichet ammecha. izdaza moshe, vela yachil lemallela, ad deasge bitzlotin uvautin kame kudesha berich hu.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe, atkif bechuresyay dili, ad degaar kudesha berich hu bechol innun ochlosin, bechol innun chayyaylin, veatkif moshe bitren luchin deavnin, veachit lon letatta. veda hu dichtiv, (Mishlei 21:22) ir gibborim ala chacham vayored oz mivtecha. umehahu ziva deishtear beh, havo mavhikin anpoy demoshe. uma behay deishtear beh la have yachlin leistakkela beanpoy, behahu deistallak minneh al achat kamma vechamma.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach, da orayyta. veal da, yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev. delet milla bealma deyitbar chelehon deammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, bar beshaata deyisrael mitassekin beorayyta. dechol zeman deyisrael mitassekin beorayyta, yemina ittekaf, veittebar chela vetukepa deovde avodat kochavim umazzalot. uvegine kach orayyta ikrit oz, kema deat amer (Tehillim 29:11) Adonai oz leammo yitten.

Uveshaata deyisrael la mitassekin beorayyta semala ittakaf, veittakaf chelehon deovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, veshaltin alayyhu, vegazrin alayyhu gizrin, dela yachlin lemekam behu. veal da itgeliu beni yisrael, veitbadaru beni ammayya.
614: (Yirmeyahu 9:12) al ma avda haaretz vegomer, vayyomer Adonai al azvam et torati. deha kol zimna deyisrael yishtaddelun beorayyta, ittevar chela vetukepa dechol ovde avoda zara, hada hu dichtiv yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev. amar ribbi elazar, vadday hachi hu, dechol zimna dekalehon deyisrael, ishtema bevatte kenesiyyot uvevatte midrashot vechulei, kema detannina (Bereshit 27:22) hakkol kol yaakov, vei lav hayyadayim yede esav, veha okimna.

(Shemot 15:7) uverov geoncha taharos kamecha. Rabbi chizkiyya patach veamar, (Tehillim 10:1) lamma Adonai taamod berachok talim leittot batztzara, beshaata dechove alma garmu, kudesha berich hu salik leella leella, uvene nasha tzavvchin venachtin dimin, velet man deyishgach alayyhu. may tama. begin deihu salik leella leella, uteshuva itmanna minnayyhu, keden ketiv, uverov geoncha taharos kamecha.

Rabbi yitzchak amar, hay kera, beshaata deitlavash kudesha berich hu gauta, al amamya deyitkanneshun aleh, kema dichtiv, (Tehillim 2:2) veroznim nosdu yachad al Adonai veal meshicho. vetana zeminin innun shivin kastorin mikkol ivar, (nusach acher ammin) leitkannesha behahu zimna beochlosin dechol alma, ulemebad kerava al yerushala 40 karta kaddisha, uleachada etin aleh dekudesha berich hu. umay amre, nokim al patrona bekadmita, ulevatar al ammeh, veal hechaleh.

Keden zamin kudesha berich hu lechayyeycha alayyhu. dichtiv, (Tehillim 2:4) yoshev bashamayim yischak Adonai yilag lamo. behahu zimna yilbash kudesha berich hu gauvta alayyhu, vishetzinun min alma, kema dichtiv, (Zecharya 14:12) vezot tihye hammaggefa asher yiggof Adonai et kol haammim asher tzavu al yerushala 40 hamek besaro vehu omed al raglav.

Ribbi abba amar mishshemeh derav yesa sava, vehachi amar rabbi shimon, zamin kudesha berich hu leachayay lechol innun malchin, deaku leyisrael veliyrushala 40, leanderianus, lelufinos, unevuchadnetzar, ulesancheriv, ulechol shear malche ammin, decharivu beteh, uleshalletaa lon kekadmita, veyitkanneshun immehon shear ammin, vezammin kudesha berich hu leitpara minnayyhu beitgalleyay, sacharane yerushalam. hada hu dichtiv, vezot tihye hammaggefa asher yiggof Adonai et kol haammim asher tzavu al yerushala 40. asher yitzbeu la ketiv, ella asher tzavu. keden ketiv, uverov geoncha taharos kamecha, veda lezimna deata meshicha, ketiv, veshirata da shirata dealmin hi.

(Shemot 15:8) uveruach appecha neermu mayim, behahu zimna. uvegin kach it behahu zimna, ulezimna demalka meshicha, ulezimna degog umagog. nitztzevu kemo ned, lezimna dealma deate, deihu chedvavta dechol almin.

(Shemot 15:9) amar oyev erdof assig achallek shalal. amar oyev, da hahu memana ravreva al mitzrae, beshaata deityehiv leh shultanuta al yisrael, chashiv deyeshetzinun techot shultaneh. ella dedachar kudesha berich hu ture alma, dahavo meginnin alayyhu. vela tema da bilchodoy, ella kol innun ravrevin dimmanan al kol ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot, vechad ityeyhiv lehu reshuta veshultanuta al yisrael, kullehu baan dishetzun yisrael techotayyhu.

Veal da, innun ammin ditchot shuletanehon deinnun memanan, kullehu gazyrin gezirin leshetzaa lon, ella dekudesha berich hu dechar ture alma, veagin alayyhu. vechad chama moshe da, shara leshabbecha lekudesha berich hu, veamar mi chamocha baelim Adonai.

Amar rabbi shimon, ilana chad ravreva illaa, takkifa, beh ittezanu illain vetattain. vehu ittecham bitresar techumin, ittakkaf bearba sitre alma, deistacharan (nusach acher daatachebaren) beduchetayyhu. shivin anafin sallekin begavveh, veittezanu minneh, beikar sharshoy yankin innun sacharaneh, veinnun anafin demishtachchin beilana.

Kad mate idan shultaneh dechol anafa vaanafa, kullehu baan leshetzaa kolla gufa deilana, deihu ikara dechullehu anafin, hahu deshalit alayyhu, veyisrael achidan beh. kad mata alayyhu shultanuta dehahu
615: Gufa deilana, chulaka deyisrael. bae lenatra lon, ulemehav shelama bechullehu. veal da shivim pare hechag, lemihav shelama leshivin anafin divgo ilana.

Veal da mi chamocha baelim Adonai. (may baelim. ilana. kema deat ameraz, 0 ki yevoshu meelim asher chemdatam. dehu ilana, dahavo falchin lechad dapevasea, damechakekayn begavveh. veikre elim ilana) mi kamocha deyaaved keovadach virachem al kolla. mi kamocha bechol hahu sacharaneh deilana deaf al gav deihu shalta, natir lecholla, natir lechol shear, vela baya lemebad immehon gemira. mi kamocha nedar bakkodesh, behahu chela illaa deikre kodesh. nedar bakkodesh mammash, veikre koach Adonai noam Adonai, veha okimna mile.

(Shemot 15:11) mi kamocha baelim Adonai. Rabbi yose patach (Kohelet 1:14) raiti et kol hammaasim asher naasu tachat hashshamesh vehinni hakkol hevel ureut ruach. shelomo malka, deistallak bechachmeta yetera al kol bene alma, hech amar dechol ovadin hevel ureut ruach. yachol af maase hatztzedaka, veha ketiv (Yeshayahu 32:17) vehaya maase hatztzedaka shalom. ella ha ukemuha, kol hammaasim asher naasu tachat hashshamesh ketiv. shani maase hatztzedaka, deihu leella min shimsha.

Vehinne hakkol hevel ureut ruach, may ka mayyre. i tema hakkol hevel kema deokimna, deihu beraza dechachmeta, kema deat amer havel havalim amar kohelet, veinnun havalim kiyyuma dealma dilella vetatta. may tema behay, dichtiv hacha, hakkol hevel ureut ruach. (veha milleta da tachat hashshemesh ketiv)

Ella hachi ukemuha, vehachi hu. ta chaze, beshaata deovadin mitkashsheran letatta, uvar nash ishtaddal befulechana demalka kaddisha, hahu milla deavid, hevel itavid minneh leella. velet lach hevel, delet leh kala, desalik veitattar leella, veitavid sannegora kame kudesha berich hu.

Vechol innun ovadin deishtaddal behu bar nash, delav innun pulechana dekudesha berich hu, hahu milla deavid, haval yitavid minneh, veazla veshatat bealma. vechad nafkat nishmateh devar nash, hahu hevel megalgela leh bealma, keavna bekusefita, kema dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 25:29) veet nefesh oyvecha yekalenna betoch kaf hakkala.

May yekalenna. hahu hevel dimgalgel leh sacharaneh bealma, keden kol millin demitabbedin (veinnun ditchot shimsha) delav innun pulechana dekudesha berich hu, hevel yitavid minnayyhu, ihu tevira derucha, demittabbar lerucha desalik venachit umitgalgel bealma, hada hu dichtiv hevel ureut ruach.

Aval hahi milla deihi pulechana demareh da salik (ikre) leella min shimsha, veitavid minneh hevel kaddisha, veda hu zara dezara bar nash behahu alma, uma shemeh. tzedaka. dichtiv, (Hoshea 10:12) ziru lachem litzdaka.

Hay medabbar leh levar nash, kad tippuk nishmateh minneh, vesalleka lah beatra dechavod dilella ishtechach leittzarra bitzrora dechayye, hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya koach) vehalach lefanecha tzidkecha begin ledabbera lach, lesalleka lach, (min atar) laatar deikre kevod Adonai. dichtiv, (yeshaya koach) kevod Adonai yaasfecha.

Kol innun nishmatin, dehahu hevel kaddisha medabbar lehu, hahu deikre kevod Adonai, kanish lon begavveh, veittzeriran beh. (hada hu dichtiv kevod Adonai yaasfecha) veda ikre nayycha derucha. aval achara ureut ruach ikre. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dechol ovadehon leella min shimsha vezarin zara ditzdaka, lemizke lon lealma deate, veal da ketiv (Malachi 3:20) vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh tzedaka.

Amar ribbi shimon, ta chaze, bekadmita kad itbeni be makdesha letatta, la itbeni ella bedina verugeza, kema dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 32:31) ki al appi veal chamati vegomer begin divaatar dedina sharya. lezimna deate, zammin kudesha berich hu lemivne leh, uleatkena leh bedarga achara illaa deikre tzedaka, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:14) bitzdaka tikkonani. begin kach itkayyaym, (beh) ushemeh
616: Mammash tzedek yitkere. menalan. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:6) veze shemo asher yikreo Adonai tzidkenu.

(Shemot 15:12) natita yemincha tivlaemo aretz. ha ittemar, arimat yemincha. amar ribbi yitzchak, ha ittearu beh chavrayyay, dechad appik kudesha berich hu lemitzrae metin mittechot mayya, amar leara, kanish lon begavvavch, vela baat, ad deoshit kudesha berich hu yemina lekabbelah, veume lah, keden belaatynun ara, hada hu dichtiv tivlaemo aretz. amar Rabbi elazar, natita yemincha: leafresha lah missemala ucheden itavid behu dina.

(Shemot 15:13) nachita bechasdecha am zu gaalta, kema dichtiv, (tehillim ma) ki yemincha uzeroacha veor panycha ki retzitam. ki yemincha: da gedola. nehalta veazzecha, da dichtiv uzeroacha, da gevura. el neve kadshecha, da dichtiv, veor panycha ki retzitam, da tzaddik. vechullehu mishtakkeche bikra.

(Shemot 15:16) tippol alehem emata vafachad. emata, ema mibbae leh, may emata. deha let lach at o milla chada beorayyta, dela it bah razin illain. may emata. amar ribbi shimon, kelomar dechilu dishchinta.

Kehay gavvna, (Shemot 15:17) teviemo vetittaemo behar nachalatcha vegomer, teviemo vetittaemo, teviem vetittaem mibbae leh, may teviemo. ella rucha dekudesha amar, al innun dara batraa, degazar yehoshua, veitgalya behu gilluya dirshima kaddisha dishmeh dekudesha berich hu, deillen achidan beh bev, veillen itchaziu lemerat ara. kema dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu aretz. dechol man deitgezar, veitgalya beh reshima kaddisha, venatir leh, ikre tzaddik, begin, kach, leolam yirshu aretz.

Veal da teviemo, 6 yetera, teviemo leinun daachidan bev. vetittaemo kema deat amer nitzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer. leinun daachidan bev, uleinnun batrae, ittear milla. velet lach milla beorayyta, o at zeera beorayyta, delet bah razin illain, vetaamin kaddishin, zakkaa chulakehon deyadin behu.

Raya mehemna pikkuda lemivne makdesha letatta, kegavvna deve makdesha dilella, kema deat amer, machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai. deitzterich lemivne be makdesha letatta, uletzallaa begavveh tzelota bechol yoma, lemiflach leh lekudesha berich hu, deha tzelota ikre avoda.
Vehahu be kenishta, itzterich lemivne leh bishfiru sagya, uleatkena leh bechol tikkunin, deha be kenishta diltatta, kayyeyma lokovel be kenishta dilella.

Bet hamikdash letatta, ihu kaim kegavvna devet hammikdash dilella, dekaim da lokovel da. vehahu be makdesha, kol tikkunoy, vechol pulechanoy, vechol innun manin, veshammashin, kullehu innun kegavvna dilella. mashkena deka aved moshe bemadbera, kolla hava kegavvna dilella.

Be makdesha devana shelomo malka, hu be nayycha kegavvna illaa, bechol innun tikkunin, lemeheve betikkuna dilella, be nayycha veachasanta. hachi be kenishta, itzterich bechol tikkune shappiru, lemeheve kegavvna illaa, lemeheve bet tzelota, leatkena tikkunin bitzlota, kema deukemuha.

Vehahu be makdesha delehevi beh (251 amud alef) challonot, dichtiv, (daneyalav) vechavvivn petichan. kegavvna dilella, veal da (Shir HaShirim 2:9) mashgiach min hachallonot metzitz min hacharakkim. vei tema afillu bechakla, begin derucha leheve salik. lav hachi, deha anan tzerichin bayit velekka. leishtakkecha bayit letatta, kegavvna devayit illaa, lenachta diyyura illaa lediyyura tattaa.
Vetu dehahu tzelota, vehahu rucha, itzterich lesalleka, velnafka miggo aku, beorach meshar, lokovel yerushalam.
617: Veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 118:5) min hammetzar karati yah, deitzterich atar dachik beaku, leshaddera begavveh hahu rucha, dela yiste limina velismala. uvechakla la yachil kala leshaddera leh hachi, deha kegavvna da kala deshofar, itdachyay levar beorach meshar, miggo atar dachik, veazil uvaka rekiin, vesalik bisliku, leatteara rucha leella.

Vei tema, ha ketiv, (Bereshit 24:63) vayyetze yitzchak lasuach bassade. shane yitzchak, demilla achara hava beh, ma dela hava bechol alma. vetu dehay kera lav lehachi ata, devadday bassade acher la hava metzalle veha okimna. (ad kan raya mehemana).

Tanya amar ribbi abba, zakkaa chulakehon, deinnun dezakkan lememar shirata da behay alma, dezakkan lememar lah bealma deate. veshirata da, itbene beesrin uteren atvavn kaddishin gelifan, uveeser amiran, vecholla itreshim bishma kaddisha, vecholla shelemuta dishma kaddisha, veha ittearna mille.

Amar ribbi shimon, behahi shaata dahavo kayymin yisrael al yamma, vahavu amre shirata, itgele kudesha berich hu alayyhu, vechol retichoy vecheloy, begin deyindeun lemalkehon, deavad lon kol innun nissin ugevuran, vechol chad vechad yada veistakkal, ma dela yadu veistakkalu shear nevie alma.

Dei tema dela yadin vela idbaku chachmeta illaa, min shirata da techome, dechullehu bechachmeta istakkalu, veyadu millin veamru. dei lav hachi, ech amru kullehu millin achdin, dela satu illen meillen, uma deamar da, amar da, vela akdim milla da, lemilla da, ella kullehu beshikkula chada, verucha dekudesha befuma dechol chad vechad, umillin ittemaru kullehu keillu nafkin mippuma chad. ella vadday kullehu bechachmeta illaa istakkalu, veyadu milin illain, verucha dekudesha befum kol chad vechad.

Vaafillu innun devime immehon, havo amre shirata kullehu kachada, vahavu chaman kullehu, ma dela chama yechezkel nevia. veal kach havo kullehu mistakkele, keillu chaman ena beena. vechad siyyeymu millin, kullehu mitbasseman benafshayyhu, vetaavon lemecheme uleistakkela, vela havo baan lenatla mittamman, missegiut tiuveta.

Behahi shaata, amar moshe lekudesha berich hu, banayich missegiut tiuveta leistakkela bach, la baan lenatla min yamma. ma aved kudesha berich hu, astim yekareh levar lemadbera, vetamman itgele vela itgele. amar lon moshe leyisrael, kamma (sefer acher zimnin lenatla mittamman, velo 82) zimnin amena lenatla mittamman vela baitun ad di achze lon ziva yekara dekudesha berich hu bemadbera, umiyyad havo taavin,

Vela natlu, ad deachid behu moshe veachme lon ziva yekara dekudesha berich hu bemadbera, keden missegiut tiuveta ureuta leistakkela, antil lon moshe, hada hu dichtiv vayassa moshe et yisrael miyyam suf vayyetzu el midbar shur. may midbar shur. madbera, dahavo baan leistakkela beh, ziva yekara demalka kaddisha, veal da ikre midbar shur: istakkeluta sham.

(Shemot 15:22) vayyelchu sheloshet yamim bammidbar velo matzu mayim. veen mayim ella tora, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 55:1) hoy kol tzame lechu lammayim. amar ribbi yesa, vechi man yahav lehu orayyta hacha, veha ad kean la ityehivat lon orayyta.

Amar ribbi elazar, innun nafku lemadbera leistakkela, kudesha berich hu natal ziva yekara dileh mittamman, veinnun azlu leistakkela (lekudesha berich hu) beh, vela ashkechuhu. veolifna dekudesha berich hu tora ikre, veen mayim ella tora, veen tora ella kudesha berich hu.

Amar ribbi shimon, ad dahavo azle bemadbera, itgele alayyhu reshuta achara, dishar ammin, hahu deshalit bemadbera, veiarau behu tamman. chamu yisrael, dela hava hahu ziva yekara demalkehon, hada hu dichtiv, vayyavou marata velo yachlu lishtot mayim mimmara. may tama. ki marim hem, la itbesam nafshayyhu kekadmita. velo od ella deate lekatrega alayyhu.
Ma ketiv, veyitzak el Adonai vayyorehu Adonai etz,
618: Veen etz ella tora, dichtiv, (Mishlei 3:18) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah. veen tora, ella kudesha berich hu. ribbi abba amar, en etz ella kudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Devarim 20:19) ki haadam etz hassade, etz hassade vadday, da etz sade detappuchin kaddishin. vechad itgele ziv yekara demalkehon alayyhu, keden vayyashlech el hammayim vayyimteku hammayim. may vayyimteku hammayim. dekattegora itavid sannegora.

Amar ribbi abba, ta chaze bekadmita kad alu yisrael bekayayma dekudesha berich hu, la alu kedka yeot. may taama. begin deitgezaru vela itperau, vela itgalleyay reshima kaddisha. kevan dematu hacha, ma ketiv, sham sam lo chok umishpat. tamman alu yisrael bitren chulakin kaddishin, behahu gilluya deitgalya reshima dilhon, veikrun chok umishpat. chok: kema deat amar (Mishlei 21) vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. umishpat: kema deittemar (Tehillim 81:5) mishpat lelohe yaakov. vesham nissahu, behahu at kaddisha.

Kema deat amer, ki chok leyisrael hu. besifra derav yiyiva sava, amar milla al hahu chutera kaddisha. (Shemot 15:26) vayyomer im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha. vayyomer, may vayyomer. la ketiv man kaamar da. ella kudesha berich hu amar. ribbi chizkiyya amar, shamenan (nusach acher mashma) amira setam, meamira setam. dichtiv, (Shemot 24:1) veel moshe amar ale el Adonai. amar, la ketiv man kaamar. uf hacha vayyomer setam, vela ketiv man kaamar.
Amar ribbi yose, mashma dichtiv, veyitzak el Adonai vayyorehu Adonai etz, mehacha mashma vayyomer, umashma man amar milla. lekol Adonai elohecha, lekoli mibbae leh. ella lehahu kol dealu beh.

Amar ribbi abba, batar deitgalya behu reshima kaddisha, alu bitren chulakin kaddishin, kema deittemar, vechevan dealu beillen teren, alu beillen teren chulakin acharanin, dechad yistallekun beillen teren acharanin, yitchabberun beillen, vela mimmane birkan, ubbegin kach, beillen matu birkan, (uvegine kach beillen mattin) ad malka kaddisha.

Umeatreh dikra ishtema milla, dichtiv, vayyomer im shamoa tishma. vayyomer: da malka kaddisha. umay kaamar, im shamoa tishma lekol Adonai elohecha, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu, da keneset yisrael. vehayyashar beenav taase: da tzaddik. vehaazanta lemitzvotav: da netzach. veshamarta kol chukkav: da hod. kevan dealu beillen, ha matu lemalka kaddisha. levatar ma ketiv, kol hammachala asher samti bemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha. ki ani Adonai: da malka kaddisha.

Ishtema, dechol man denatir lehay reshima kaddisha, mineh salik ad malka kaddisha illaa. may mashma. mashma innun teren, deitkenash behu zara, umashach revut kudesha, deshadyayn leh befum ama, (veal da) itkashsharu kachada, umalka illaa alayyhu, veitkashsharu beh. veal kach, man deal beillen teren, venatir lon, itkashshar bitren acharanin, veal behu, ucheden mate lemalka kaddisha.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday man dezache betzadik, zache benetzach vehod, veillen innun telata, deitbarcha behu keneset yisrael. uman dezachu behu, zache bemalka kaddisha, veal bechullehu arbea.

Velokovle arbea illen, netiru lehay reshima kaddisha, mearba millin: netiru dichneset yisrael, istammeruta denidda. netiru detzaddik, istammeruta deshifcha. netiru denetzach, istammeruta devat avodat kochavim umazzalot. netiru dehod, istammeruta dezona. veal da lekol Adonai elohecha, da keneset yisrael.

Bamme zachan yisrael lekabbela appe shechinta, beistammeruta min nidda. veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 18:19) veel ishsha beniddat tumatah lo tikrav legallot ervatah. may legallot ervatah da keneset yisrael. uvehay achidan umitkashsheran millin acharanin, dichneset yisrael itkashsherat behu. veha ukemuha mille.
Vehayyashar beenav taase: da tzaddik. kema dichtiv, (tehillim la) ene Adonai el tzaddikim, leistammera mishshifcha.
619: Veha okimna mille. dichtiv, (Mishlei 30:23) veshifcha ki tirash gevirtah, degarim latztzaddik deitdabbak beshifcha. vehaazanta lemitzvotav: da netzach, leistammera (dela sheker beh) dela yeul reshima da bevat el nechar, velo yeshakker beh benetzach. dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 15:29) vegam netzach yisrael lo yeshakker. uman denatir hay, kiyyem mitzvotav, dichtiv, (Shemot la) ki lo tishtachave leel acher. veshamarta kol chukkav: da hod, leistammera min zona.

Veazla ha, kema detanenan, amar ribbi yehuda, may dichtiv (Tehillim 45:4) chagor charbecha al yarech gibbor hodcha vahadarecha. ella, kol man dimzarez garmeh, veshavve dechilu decharba shinnana takkifa lokovleh. al yarech, may al yarech. da reshima kaddisha. kema deat amer, (Bereshit 24:2) sim na yadcha tachat yerechi.

Davar acher chagor charbecha, kelomar, zarez veatkif yitzrecha bisha, deihu charbecha. al yarech, al hahu reshima kaddisha lenatra leh. vei natar leh, keden ikre gibbor, vekudesha berich hu albish leh bilvushoy, uman levushoy dekudesha berich hu. hod venetzach. (nusach acher vahadar) dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:1) hod vehadar lavashta. uf hacha hodcha vahadarecha, ucheden itdabbak bar nash bemalka kaddisha kedka yeot.

Mikkan ulehala, kol hammachala asher samti bemitzrayim lo asim alecha ki ani Adonai rofecha. da malka kaddisha, veal da azhar lon al hahu milla mammash, deyahav verashim behu, vela yattir vead kean la ityeyhivat lehu orayyta, ella kevan dichtiv, sham sam lo chok umishpat, miyyad vayyomer im shamoa tishma vegomer.

Ta chaze, kad baa kudesha berich hu leazhara leyisrael, al orayyta, bechamma millin mashich lehu, bechamma meshichan dachavivuta, kevar nash demashich bereh leve rav. veta chaze, la baa kudesha berich hu lemehav lehu orayyta, ad dekarivu bahadeh. uvamme kerivu bahadeh, begilluya dirshima da, kema deittemar.

Amar Rabbi yehuda, la kerivu yisrael letura desinay, ad dealu bechulaka detzaddik, vezachu beh. menalan, dichtiv, (Shemot 19:1) bayyom hazze bau midbar sinay, bayyom hazzehi mammash parashat haman kivvinu lo vegomer.

[Parashat haman] (Shemot 16:4) vayyomer Adonai el moshe hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. ribbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. hay kera okimna leh, beshaata devar nash shachiv beve mareh, ha ittefas beatronya demalka, resheh bekulera, ragloy bechufesirin, (sefer acher batepaseraa) kamma chelin natrin leh, mehay gisa, umehay gisa. shayyfoy kullehu bedochaka, maggichin illen beillen. mechla itade minneh.

Behahu zimna, pakdin aleh appotrofa, lemelaf aleh zechut kame malka, dichtiv, (Iyov 33:23) im yesh alav malach melitz echad minni alef. behahi shaata, zakkaa chulakeh debar nash deal aleh, veolif leh archa, leshezavuteh min dina. hada hu dichtiv ashre maskil el dal.

Vehecha yachil leshezava leh, lemelaf leh archoy dechayye, leatava lekame mareh, keden itavid appotrofosa aleh leella. may agreh. beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai. davar acher, ashre maskil el dal, kamma takkifa agra demiskena, kame kudesha berich hu.

Amar ribbi chiyyay, tavavhna al hay kera dichtiv, (Tehillim 69:34) ki shomea el evyonim Adonai, vechi el evyonim shomea velo leachara. amar ribbi shimon, begin deinnun kerivin yattir lemalka, dichtiv, (Tehillim 51:19) lev nishbar venidke elohim lo tivze. velet lach bealma, deihu tavir libba kemiskena. tu amar ribbi shimon, ta chaze, kol innun beni alma, itchazyayn kame kudesha berich hu, begufa venafsha, umiskena la itchaze ella benafsha bilchodoy, vekudesha berich hu kariv lenafsha yattir miggufa.
Miskena chad hava bishvivuteh der yesa, vela hava man deashgach beh, vehu hava achsif, vela takkif bivne nasha,
620: Yoma chad challash, al aleh ribbi yesa, shama chad kala deamar, tilka tilka, ha nafsha parcha gabbay, vela matu yomoy. vavy livni mateh dela ishtechach behu deyativ nafsheh legabbeh. kam ribbi yesa, shadde befumeh, mayya degargerin, afuta dekuneta (sefer acher dakevapetaa) itbeza ziyia beanpoy, vetav rucheh legabbeh.

Levatar ata veshail leh, amar chayyecha ribbi, nafsha nafkat minnay, umatu lah kame kuresyay demalka, uvaat leishtaara tamman, ella devaa kudesha berich hu lezakkaa lach, veachrizu alach, zammin hu ribbi (Vayikra 79 amud alef 150 amud alef) yesa, lesalleka rucheh, uleitkeshshera bechad idra kaddisha dizminin chavrayyay leitteara beara, veha atkinu telat kurseyan, dekayymin lach ulechavrach. mehahu yoma havo mashgichin beh bene mateh.

Tu, miskena achara avar kameh der yitzchak, vahava bideh pelag mea dechesef. amar leh leribbi yitzchak, ashlim li velivnay velivnatay nafshaan. amar leh vehech ashlim nafshayychu, deha la ishtechach gabbay bar pelag mea. amar leh, beda ashlimna, biflag achara deit gabbay, afkeh veyahaveh leh.

Achziu leh bechelmeh, dehava avar bisfata deyamma rabba, uvaan lemishdeyeh begavvevy, (vaychi 218 amud alef) chama leribbi shimon, dehava oshit yedoy lokovleh, veate hahu miskena veafkeh, veyahaveh bidoy deribbi shimon, veishteziv. kad ittear, nafal befumeh, hay kera, (Tehillim 41:2) ashre maskil el dal beyom raa yemalletehu Adonai.

Veta chaze, kol yoma veyoma, natif talla meattika kaddisha lizer appin, umitbarchan kol chakal tappuchin kaddishin. umehahu talla angid leinun diltatta, umalachin kaddishin ittezanu minneh, kol chad vechad kefum mechaleh, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 78:25) lechem abbirim achal ish, umehahu mezona achlu yisrael bemadbera.

Amar ribbi shimon, kamma bene nasha mittezanin behay zimna minneh, uman innun. illen chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, yome velele. vechi salleka datach mehahu mezona mammash. la. ella keen hahu mezona mammash, deshakil al chad teren.

Ta chaze, yisrael kad alu veitdevaku bemalka kaddisha, begin gilluya dirshima kaddisha, keden zachu lemechal nahama achara illaa, yattir mimma dehava bekadmita. bekadmita kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, alu benahama, deikre matztza, vehasheta zachu, vealu lemechal nahama achara illaa yattir, meatar illaa, dichtiv hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. min hashshamayim mammash. uvehahu zimna ishtechach lehu leyisrael. meatar da. chavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, meatar achara illaa yattir ittezanu. may hu. kema dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. atar illaa yattir.

Amar leh Rabbi elazar, i hachi, amay chalsha nafshayyhu yattir mishshear bene alma, deha shear bene nasha, bechela vetukepa yattir itchazun leishtakkecha. (sefer acher inun yattir) amar leh yeot shailta.

Ta chaze, kol mezoni divne alma milleella ka atyayn. hahu mezona deate min shemayya veara, da mezona dechol alma, vehu mezona dechola, vehu mezona gas veav. vehahu mezona deate yattir meella, hu mezona yattir dakik, kaatya meatar dedina ishtechach, veda hu mezona deachlu yisrael kad nafku mimmitzrayim. (yattir dekika) mezona deishtechach lehu leyisrael, behahu zimna bemadbera, meatar illaa deikre shamayim, hu mezona yattir dekika, deayil yattir lenafsha mikkolla, umitperash yattir miggufa, veikre lechem abbirim.

Mezona illaa yattir mikkolla, hu mezona dechavrayyay, innun demishtaddele beorayyta, deachle mezona derucha venishmeta, vela achle mezona degufa kelal, vehayeynu meatar illaa yakkira al kolla, veikre chachma. begine kach chalish gufa dechavrayyay, yattir mibbene alma, deha la achle mezona degufa kelal. veachle mezona derucha venishmeta, meatar rechika illaa,
621: Yakkira mikkolla. uvegine kach hahu mezona dakik min dekika, yattir mikkolla. zakkaa chulakehon, hada hu dichtiv, (Kohelet 7:12) hachachma techayye vealeha. zakkaa chulaka degufa, deyachil leittezana bimzona denafsha.

Amar leh Rabbi elazar, vadday hachi hu. aval behay zimna, ech ishtakkeche mezone illen. amar leh vadday yeot shailta. ta chaze, veda hu beriru demilla, mezona kadmaa, hu mezona dechol alma, hahu deatya min shemayya veara, vehu mezona degufa. (sefer acher decholla)
