Mezona dehu illaa minneh, hahu deihu dekika yattir, veata meatar dedina sharya, deikre tzedek, veda hu mezona demiskene. veraza demilla, man deashlim lemiskena, ashlim leh at chad, veitavid tzedaka, veraza da (Mishlei 11:17) gomel nafsho ish chesed. gemilut chasadim mashma, deha bedina sharya, veashlim leh chesed, keden hu rachame.

Mezona illaa yattir meillen, hu mezona illaa veyakkira, meatar deikre shamayim, vehu dakik mikkullehu, vehu mezona divne mare, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 41:4) Adonai yisadennu al eres devay kol mishkavo hafachta vechalyo. Adonai, dayyka, may tama. begin dehane bene mare, la ittezne ella behahu dekudesha berich hu mammash. (umay ihu, chelev vedam. hada hu dichtiv 1 lehakeriv li chelev vedam. veda hu mezona meatar deikre shamayim, vehu yakkira vaayleah dakik mikkolla)
Mezona illaa kaddisha veyakkira da hu mezone deruchin venishmatin, vehu mezona daatar rechika illaa, (sefer acher mehahu atar deikre noam Adonai.)

Veyakkira mikkolla, hu mezona dechavrayyay demishtaddele beorayyta, vehu mezona deate mechachma illaa. may tama meatar da. begin deorayyta nafka (Bereshit 47 amud bet, Vayikra 186 amud bet 198 amud bet) mechachma illaa, veinnun demishtaddele beorayyta, ayyle beikara desharshaha, veal da, mezona dilhon, mehahu atar illaa kaddisha ka atya.

Ata Rabbi elazar, venashik yedoy. amar, zakkaa chulaki dekaimna bemillin illen. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, demishtaddele beorayyta yemama velele, dezache lon behay alma, uvealma deate, dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha.

(Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim. ribbi yose patach, (Tehillim 145:16) poteach et yadecha umasbia lechol chay ratzon. ma ketiv leella, ene chol elecha yesabberu. kol innun beni alma, metzappan vezakfan ayynin lekudesha berich hu, begin kach, (sefer acher aval) kol innun bene mehemanuta baan (sefer acher atzetareyken lemive) bechol yoma veyoma, leshaala mezonayyhu mikudesha berich hu, uletzallaa tzelotehon aleh.

May tama. begin dechol man dimtzale tzeloteh legabbe kudesha berich hu al mezoneh, garim deyitbarech kol yoma al yedoy, hahu ilana demazon decholla beh. (vetaama demilla 0 baruch Adonai yom yom) veaf al gav deishtechach immeh, bae lemishal kame kudesha berich hu, uletzallaa tzelota al mezona kol yoma, begin deyishtechachu al yedoy birkan kol yoma veyoma leella, veda hu baruch Adonai yom yom.

Val da, la livae leh leeynash levashshela mezona, min yoma leyoma acharina, dela leakkev yoma leyoma achara. hada hu dichtiv veyatza haam velaktu devar yom beyomo. yom beyomo, dayyka. bar meerev shabbat leshabbat, kema deokimna. ucheden ishtechach kudesha berich hu male birkan bechol yoma. ucheden ketiv poteach et yadecha vegomer. may ratzon. hahu ratzon deishtechach meattika kaddisha, venafik minneh ratzon, leishtakkecha mezone lecholla. uman deshail mezone bechol yoma veyoma, hahu ikre bera mehemana, beraza divgineh mishtachchan birkan leella.

Rabbi abba patach veamar, (Tehillim 147:11) rotze Adonai et yereav et hameyachalim lechasdo, kamma it lehu livne nasha lemehach bearchoy demalka kaddisha, ulemehach bearchoy deorayyta, begin deyishtakkechun birkan lechullehu, leillae uletattae.
Detanya, maydichtiv, (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar. etpaar vday. may mashma. divgin
622: Yisrael letatta, kudesha berich hu mitpaar leella. umay peera dileh. deitchabbash bitfilin, demitchabbera gavvni leitpaara.

Tana, rotze Adonai et yereav, rotze Adonai bireav mibbae leh. may rotze Adonai et yereav, ella rotze Adonai et yereav, kelomar, appik hay ratzon, umitrae (nusach acher vaataydaa) behu kudesha berich hu, lireav dedachalin leh. uman innun yereav deappik lon hay ratzon. hadar veamar, et hameyachalim lechasdo, innun dimtzafan umechakkan bechol yoma veyoma, lemibbae mezonayyhu min kudesha berich hu, mashma dichtiv et hameyachalim lechasdo.

Ribbi yesa sava, la atkin seudata bechol yoma, ad devaa bauteh kame kudesha berich hu, al mezone. amar, la natkin seudata, ad detityehiv mibbe malka. levatar devae bauteh kame kudesha berich hu, hava mechakke shaata chada, amar ha idan detityehiv mibbe malka, mikkan ulehala atkinu seudata. veda hu archa, deinnun dachale kudesha berich hu, dachale chattaa.

Innun chayyayvayya deazlin akimin bearche orayyta, ma ketiv behu. (Yeshayahu Adonai:11) hoy mashkime vabboker shechar yirdofu. veal da rotze Adonai et yereav et hameyachalim lechasdo. lechasdo dayyka. (sefer acher uveha) ishtemodan innun bene mehemanuta bechol yoma veyoma, hada hu dichtiv, veyatza haam velaktu devar yom beyomo. yom beyomo kaamar, velo devar yom leyom acher.

Vechol kach lamma. lemaan anassennu hayelech betorati im lo bechan ishtemodan innun bene mehemanuta, dechol yoma veyoma innun azle beorach meshar beorayyta. ribbi yitzchak amar mehacha, (Mishlei 13:25) tzaddik ochel lesova nafsho, batar desava nafsheh milletzalle ulemikre beorayyta.

Ribbi shimon amar, ta chaze, ad la yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael, avchin ben innun beni mehemanuta, uven innun chayyayvayya delav innun beni mehemanuta, vela kayymin beorayyta. uvamme avchin lon. bamman. kema deittemar anassennu. vechol innun deishtechachu deinnun bene mehemanuta, rashim leh kudesha berich hu, birshimu dechitra dechesed, kema deat amer hameyachalim lechasdo, veal da lemaan anassennu. vechol innun dela mishtakkeche beni mehemanuta, ade minnayyhu kitra illaa da. umana achriz veamar, (Mishlei 13:25) uveten reshaim techsar. veim kol da lo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir.

Tana, behahu shaata ishtelimu yisrael letatta, kegavvna dilella, kema deokimna, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:27) vayyavou elima vesham shetem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim vegomer. veittakkaf ilana kaddisha, bitresar techumin, bearba sitre alma. veittakkaf beshivin anfin, vecholla kegavvna dilella.

Behahi shaata, natif talla kaddisha, meattika setimaa, umalya leresheh dizer anpin, atar deikre shamayim. umehahu talla dinhora illaa kaddisha, hava nagid venachit mana letatta. vechad hava nachit, hava mitperash gelidin gelidin, veakrish letatta. hada hu dichtiv dak kakkefor al haaretz.

Kol innun bene mehemanuta, nafke velakte, umevarchan shema kaddisha aleh. vehahu mana, hava salik rechin dechol busemin deginta deeden, deha beh itmeshach venachit letatta. shavye lekameh, bechol taama deihu bae, hachi taim leh, umevarech lemalka kaddisha illaa.
Ucheden mitbarech bemeoy, vahava mistakkel veyada leella, veistache bechachma illaa, veal da ikrun dor dea. veillen havo bene mehemanuta, ulehon ityehivat orayyta leistakkela bah, uleminda archaha.

Veinnun dela ishtechachu beni mehemanuta, ma ketiv behu, (Bamidbar 11:8) shatu haam velaktu. may shatu. shetuta havo nasbe legarmayyhu, begin dela havo bene mehemanuta. ma ketiv behu. vetachanu varechayim o dachu bammedocha vegomer. man atrach
623: Lon kol hay. ella deinnun la havo bene mehemanuta.

Kegavvna da, innun dela mehemne beh bekudesha berich hu, la baan leistakkela bearchoy, veinnun baan leatrecha garmayyhu kol yoma batar mezona, yemama velele, dilma la salik bidayyhu pitta denahama. man garim lon hay. begin delav innun bene mehemanuta.

Uf hacha, shatu haam velaktu, shatu bishttuta degarmayyhu, uvaan leatrecha aleh, hada hu dichtiv, vetachanu varechayim. batar kol tircha da, la salik bidayyhu, ella dichtiv vehaya tamo ketaam leshad hashshamen. vela yattir. man garim lon hay, begin dela havo bene mehemanuta.

Amar ribbi yose, may leshad hashshamen. ikka deamre, delish bemishcha, ketargumo. veikka deamre, ma hashshed itchazar lechamma gavvnin, uf mana, itchazar lechamma gavvnin. ribbi yehuda amar, leshad hashshamen, yenika demishcha.

Ribbi yitzchak amar, ish lefi achlo lakatu. vechi man deachil kima, lakit kima, uman deachil yattir, lakit yattir, veha ketiv lo hedif hammarbe vehammamit lo hechsir. ella lefum innun deachlin laktin. mashma achlo, man dehava achil leh, uvegine kach la ketiv achilato.

May ka mayyre. achid bar nash beavda, o beamata, veamar dehu dileh. ata chavreh, veamar, hay avda dili hu. kerivu lekameh demoshe ledina, amar lon kamma nafshaan bevetecha, vechamma nafshaan beveteh deden, amar kach vechach. vehahu shaata amar lon moshe, lakatu machar, vechol chad minnayychu yete legabbay. lemachar, nafku velaktu, veatyayn kame moshe, shavvyayn kameh mana, hava madid leh. i hahu avda deden, ashkach hahu omra deavda, behay mana. deha chad omra lechol nefesh venefesh mibbeteh. madid leden, veishtechach chasra, hahu mechla deavda, behahu mana dileh, vechad omra lechol nefesh venefesh mibbeteh. amar avda deden hu, hada hu dichtiv ish lefi achlo lakatu uchetiv omer laggulgolet mispar nafshotechem.

Amar Rabbi (nusach acher yesa) chiyyay, ketiv, (Shemot 16:6-7) erev vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai. erev vidatem, bemay yindeun. ella hachi tana, bechol yoma veyoma ishtechachu nimuse kudesha berich hu. betzafra, ittear chesed bealma. behahu zimna deikre erev, talya dina bealma, veha ukemuha, divgine kach, yitzchak tikken tefillat hammincha. (may ka mayyre) veal da, erev vidatem, kad ittear dina bealma, tindeun, divhahu dina appik Adonai yatchon mimmitzrayim. uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai deha behahu zimna ittear chesed bealma veyitten lechu lemechal.

Rabbi chiyyay amar ippecha, ma ketiv leella, beshivtenu al sir habbasar vegomer. beh shaata, ittear erev, dehahu zimna deittear dina, ittear name chesed bealma. hada hu dichtiv, vidatem ki Adonai hotzi etchem meeretz mitzrayim. tindeun hahu chesed deavad immechon, bezimna dedina veappik yatchon meara demitzrayim. uvoker ureitem et kevod Adonai, kevod Adonai ha yedia. vekol kach lamma. bishmoa Adonai et telunnotechem vegomer.
Amar Rabbi yesa, la shane kudesha berich hu nimusoy, bar deinnun chayyayve alma shanyayn lon, umehappeche rachame ledina, kema deittemar.

Tane Rabbi elazar, mehay mana zeminin tzaddikayyay lemechal lealma deate, vei tema behay gavvna. la. ella yattir, dela hava ken lealmin. may ihu. kema deokimna dichtiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. uchetiv (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha vegomer.

(Shemot 16:29) reu ki Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat. Rabbi chizkiyya patach (Tehillim 130:1) shir hammaalot mimmaamakkim keraticha Adonai. shir hammaalot satam, vela parish man amaru. ella shir hammaalot, dizminin
624: Kol bene alma lememar, dezammin hay shir lememreh ledare alma.

Umay hu mimmaamakkim keraticha. hachi tana, kol man dimtzale tzelota kame malka kaddisha, bae lemibbae bauteh, uletzallaa (Vayikra amud alef) meimka delibba, begin deyishtechach libbeh shelim bekudesha berich hu, vichavven libba ureuta. umi amar david hachi, veha ketiv, (Tehillim 119:10) bechol libbi derashticha. veda kera saggi, may bae mimmaamakkim.

Ella hachi tana, kol bar nash devae bauteh kame malka, bae lechavvevna data (nusach acher lavo) ureuta, meikkara dechol ikarin, leamshacha birkan meimka devera, (nusach acher decholla) begin deyangid birkan mimmabbua decholla. umay hu. hahu atar denafik minneh, veishtechach minneh, hahu nahar, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden. uchetiv (Tehillim 46:5) nahar pelagav yesamchu ir elohim. veda ikre mimmaamakkim. (49 amud alef) imka decholla, imka devera, demabbuin nafkin venagdin levarcha kolla. veda hu sheruta leamshacha birkan meella letatta.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, (Bereshit 234 amud alef, Vayikra 285 1 2, 297 amud bet) kad attika setimaa dechol setimin, bae lezamna birkan lealmin, ashre kolla, veachlil kolla, behay amika illaa, umehacha shaiv veitnegid bera (nusach acher nahara) denachalin umabbuin itnegidu minneh, umitshakyayn minneh kullehu. uman dimtzale tzeloteh, bae lechavvevna libba ureuta, leamshacha birkan mehahu amika decholla, begin deyitkabbal tzeloteh, veyitavid reuteh.

Vayyomer moshe alehem ish al yoter mimmennu ad boker. amar ribbi yehuda, bechol yoma veyoma, mitbarech alma mehahu yoma illaa, deha kol shita yomin mitbarchan miyyoma sheviaa. vechol yoma yahiv mehahu beracha dekabbil behahu yoma dileh.

Veal da moshe amar, ish al yoter mimmennu ad boker. may tama. begin dela yahiv, vela yozif yoma da lechavreh, ella kol chad vechad shalit bilchodoy, behahu yoma dileh. deha la shalit yoma beyoma dechavreh.

Begine kach, kol innun (nusach acher amar rabbi yehuda kol yoma veyoma mitbarech mehahu yoma ilaa yoma sheviaa umitbarchan kol shita yomin kol chad vechad bilchodoy vechol yoma yahiv beyoma dileh mehahu beracha dekabbil mehahu yoma ilaa veal da moshe amar ish el yoter mimmennu ad bakar deha lo shallit yoma beyoma delav dileh vechol inun) chamishsha yomin shallitin beyomayyhu, veishtechach beh, ma dekabbilu, veyoma shetitaa ishtechach beh yattir. veazla ha, keha deamar ribbi elazar, may dichtiv yom hashshishshi, vela ittemar hachi bechol shear yomin. ella hachi ukemuha, hashshishshi. deizdavvevga (daazademanea) beh matronita. leatkena patora lemalka, ubbegin kach, ishtechachu beh teren chulakin, chad leyomeh, vechad letikkuna, bechedvavta demalka bematronita.

Vehahu lelya, chedvavta dematronita bemalka, veziuuga dilhon, umitbarchan kol shita yomin, kol chad vechad bilchodoy. begin kach, bae bar nash lesaddera patoreh belelya deshabbeta, begin deshari aleh birkan milleella, uvirkata la ishtechach al patora rekanya, (vehahu lelya chedvata dematronita bemalka veziuuga dilhon) begin kach, talmide chachamim deyadin raza da, ziuuga dilhon meerev shabbat leerev shabbat.

Reu ki Adonai natan lachem hashshabbat, may shabbat. yoma deveh nayychin shear yomin, vehu kelala dechol innun shita acharanin, uminneh mitbarchin. ribbi yesa amar, vechen name keneset yisrael ikre shabbat, begin deihi bat zugo, veda hi kalla. dichtiv (Shemot 31:14) ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi lachem. lachem vela lishar ammin, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 31:14) beni uven bene yisrael. veda hi achasanat yerutat almin leyisrael. veal da, ketiv (Yeshayahu 58:13) im tashiv mishshabbat raglecha vegomer uveatrih okimna mille.

Ketiv al yetze ish mimmekomo bayyom hashshevii. mimmekomo. tanenan, mehahu makom deitchaze lemehach. veraza demilla dichtiv, (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo, veda ihu makom. veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 3:Adonai) ki hammakom asher atta omed alav admat kodesh hu. atar yedia karenan leh makom deishtemoda yekara illaa.
Uvegin kach, azharuta levar nash, deka mitattera beittura kaddisha dilella, dela yippuk minneh befumeh millula (amud alef amud bet) dechol, begin dei yippuk minneh, ka
625: Mechallel yoma deshabbeta, bidoy beovadta. beragloy, lemehach levar mitteren alfin ammin. kol illen chillula deshabbeta innun.

Al yetze ish mimmekomo, da ihu atar yakkira dikdushsha, deha levar minneh, elohim acherim ninhu. baruch kevod Adonai, da kavod dilella. mimmekomo, da kavod diltatta. da ihu raza daattara deshabbat, begin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo. zakkaa chulakeh man dezache likara deshabbeta zakkaa ihu bealma den uvealma deate.

(Shemot 17:5) vayyomer Adonai el moshe avor lifne haam vegomer. ribbi chiyay patach, (tehillim la) chone malach Adonai saviv lireav vaychalletzem. zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu itree bikarehon, yattir al dileh. ta chaze, kamma innun bene alma, dimcharfe umegaddefe leella, kegon sancheriv cheref vegiddef, veamar (Melachim 2 18:35) mi bechol elohe haaratzot vegomer. vekudesha berich hu machil, vela tava minnih. kevan deoshit yedeh al chizkiyya, ma ketiv (Melachim 2 19:35) vayyetze malach Adonai vayyach bemachani ashshur vegomer.

Yaravam ben nevat hava palach leavoda zara, umekatar lah, umezavach lah, vekudesha berich hu la tava minneh. vechad ata ido nevia, veitnabbe aleh, veoshit yaravam yeda lekavleh, ma ketiv (Melachim 1 13:4) vattivash yado vegomer, velo yachol lahashivah elav. (veal defalach laavoda zara lo tava leh kudesha berich hu)

Paro cheref vegiddef, veamar (Shemot 5) mi Adonai vegomer. vekudesha berich hu la tava minneh, ad desariv behu beyisrael, dichtiv, (Shemot 9:17) odcha mistolel beammi. (Shemot 9:17) hinne yad Adonai hoya bemiknech vegomer, vechen bechol atar, kudesha berich hu tava elbona detzaddikayyay yattir al dileh.
Hacha moshe, amar od meat usekaluni, amar leh kudesha berich hu, moshe lav iddan hu lemitba elbonach, ella avor lifne haam, veachme man yoshit yedoy lokovlach, vechi birshutayyhu at kaim, o birshuti.

Umattecha asher hikkita bo et hayeor kach beyadcha vehalachta. may tama. mishshum dimchakkek bannissin hava, ushema kaddisha illaa reshima beh. bekadmita nachash, kema deittemar, (Mishlei 30:19) derech nachash ale tzur. nachash, ha ityeda deittear tzur. (nusach acher veittemar tzur) bean atar itgele, hacha itgele dichtiv hinni omed lefanecha sham al hatztzur. uman tzur. kema deat amer (Devarim lak) hatztzur tamim poolo, vetamman yada moshe hech kaim nachash ale tzur. veha okimna mille.

Amar ribbi yehuda, i lishtik kera yeot shailta. ella ha ketiv, vehikkita vatztzur vayyatzu mimmennu mayim. amar leh, vadday hachi hu, delet lach kol shema ushema, meinnun shemahan kaddishin dekudesha berich hu, dela aved nissin ugevuran, veappik kolla deitzterich lealma, kol shekken leappaka hacha mayya.

Amar leh, i hachi, ha ketiv, (Tehillim 78:20) hen hikka tzur vayyazuvu mayim. man mache lishmeh. amar leh, pattisha charifa, bekitroy yedia, veat shail da. ella ta chaze, bechol atar tzur gevura, vechad bae kudesha berich hu lemachaa, o lealkaa, ittear gevura da vehahu gevura mache velake, veda hu dichtiv, hen hikka tzur vayyazuvu mayim. vei lav deittear tzur, velake beatar deitzterich, la naviin mayya.

Amar leh, i hachi, ha ketiv, (Devarim 32:18) tzur yeladcha teshi. vetanenan may teshi, kelomar challasht leh. amar leh vadday hachi hu, deilmale yindeun chayyayvayya, dehay tzur zemina leitteara lokovlayyhu, ulealkaa lon, yimmanun millemechav kameh, ella chalsha ihi beenayyhu, hoil vela mistakkele bah, vela mistakkele beorchayyeyhu (sefer acher bakeraseyyhav) veal da tzur yeladcha teshi.

Rabbi abba amar, it tzur, veit tzur, missitra detzur illaa, nafak tzur achara. umay tzur illaa. tzur dechol tzurim. umay ihu, hahu deolidat leyisrael, dichtiv tzur yeladcha teshi. deha missitra detzur illaa dilella, nafka tzur achara. missitra deima, nafka gevura.

Veazla ha keha deamar ribbi elazar, ketiv (Tehillim 106:2) mi (83 amud alef) yemallel gevurot Adonai. may gevurot Adonai. leachlela ima illaa decholla, deaf al gav delav ihi dina, missitraha ishtechach, deha missitraha
626: Gevura ishtechach, uvegine kach tzur illaa ikre. (Devarim 32:18) vattishkach el mechollecha, da nehiru deabba. may nihu. chesed illaa, deihu nehiru deabba.

Tu amar ribbi abba, mayim bechol makom, ha yedia, vekudesha berich hu behay tzur ittear learka mayya, deha la itchaze, (ella magedavelah) veda hu at venisa dekudesha berich hu. veal da shavach david veamar, (Tehillim 114:8) hahofchi hatztzur agam mayim vegomer. umashma hahofchi, deha lav archoy detzur bechach.
Veal da, betzur illaa, appik mayya meatar diltatta. uma shemeh dehahu diltatta. sela. dichtiv, (Bamidbar 20:8) vehotzeta lahem mayim min hassela. uvamme appik hay sela mayya. bechela detzur dilella.

Rabbi shimon amar, (Devarim 32:4) hatztzur tamim poolo may mashma hatztzur tamim poolo. deithappach tzur, lemebad poolo detamim. umay ihu. avraham. dichtiv beh (Bereshit 17:1) hithallech lefanay vehye tamim. veda hu hahofchi hatztzur agam mayim, umashma tamim poolo, veda avraham.

Beshaata da, ithaddar hatztzur, tamim. beshaata achara tinyayna, kad (itanash) baa moshe leappaka mayya behay tzur, bechovayyhu deyisrael, la ithaddar tamim, kekadmita. beh zimna, itraam moshe veamar, tzur yeladcha teshi. kelomar, challasht leh mimma dehava bekadmita, divginach la ishtechach tamim hasheta, veitavid (beh) dina, ma dela hava beyome yeladcha, kelomar ulemach.

Amar ribbi abba, may dichtiv hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin. vechi tippeshin havo yisrael dela yade milla da, veha chamu shechinta kamayyhu, vaaneni kavod alayyhu desachron lon, veinnun amru hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin, guverin dechamu ziv yekara demalkehon al yamma, vetanenan, raata shifcha al hayyam ma shello raa yechezkel, innun ishtechachu tippeshin, veamru hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin.

Ella (nasha 129 amud alef) hachi kaamar rabbi shimon, bau leminda, ben attika setimaa dechol setimin, deikre ayin. uven zeer appin deikre Adonai. veal da, la ketiv hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im lo, kema dichtiv hayelech betorati im lo. ella hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin.

I hachi amay itanshu. ella al daavidu piruda, vaavidu benisyona, dichtiv veal nassotam et Adonai. amru yisrael, i hay nishal begavvna chad. vei hay nishal begavvna achara. veal da miyyad vayyavo amalek.

(Shemot 17:8) vayyavo amalek vayyillachem im yisrael birfidim. ribbi yose patach, (Yeshayahu 32:20) (6 amud alef) ashrechem zore al kol mayim meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor. ashrechem zore al kol mayim, tamman taninan, kamma mayim vechamma mayim mishtakkechin. zakkain innun yisrael, delet zara lehu, ella al hammayim, dichtiv veyyachanu sham al hammayim, innun dahavo techot anfe ilana dekudesha berich hu.

Detanya, ilana it lekudesha berich hu, vehu ilana ravreva vetakkifa, uveh ishtechach mezona lecholla. vehu ittecham bitresar techumin, bematkela, veittakkaf bearba ruche alma. ve anpin achidan beh veyisrael mishtakkeche begufa dehahu ilana. veinnun shivin anpin sacharana dilhon.

Vehayeynu dichtiv, vayyavou elima vesham shetem esre enot mayim veshivim temarim, veha ukemuha, veittemar bechamma atar. may veyyachanu sham al hammayim. ella behahu zimna, shalitu al innun mayya, deinnun techot anpin deilana, deikrun (Tehillim 124:5) hammayim hazzedonim. veal da ashrechem zore al kol mayim.

Meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor, innun teren kitre semala, daachidan behu ammin ovde kochavim umazzalot, deikrun shor vachamor. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit lak) vayhi li shor vachamor. begin delavan chakkim hava bacharashin uveinnun kitrin tattain, uveinnun baa leovada leyaakov, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 26:5) arami oved avi, veha ittemar. uchesheyyisrael zakkain, meshalleche lehu, vela yachle leshalletaa alayyhu, hada hu dichtiv meshalleche regel hashshor vehachamor dela shalte behu.
Amar ribbi abba, kad mizdavvevge kachada, la yachle bene alma lemekam behu, veal da
627: Ketiv (Devarim 22:10) lo tacharosh beshor uvachamor yachdav. yachdav dayyka. vetanenan, la yahiv inish ducheta lezinin bishin, deha beovada debar nash (letatta), ittear ma dela itzterich. vechad mizdavvevge kachada, (lo yachlin lemekam behu. mibben sitra dilhon nafik) mittekifuta dilhon deikre kelev, veda chatzifa mikkullehu, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 11:7) ulechol bene yisrael lo yechoratz kelev leshono. (nusach acher matekaypavetaa dilhon appik hahu deikre kelev, veda chatzifa mikkullehu) amar kudesha berich hu, attun amartun, hayesh Adonai bekirbenu im ayin, hare ani moser etchem lakkelev. miyyad vayyavo amalek.
Rabbi yehuda amar, (Bamidbar 24:20) reshit goyim amalek veacharito ade oved. vechi reshit goyim amalek, vahalo kamma lishanin veammin veumin havo bealma, ad la ata amalek.

Ella, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, dechilu veemata nafla al kol ammin dealma miyyisrael, hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 15:14) shamu ammim yirgazun chil achaz yoshve pelashet. vela havo amma dela hava dachil miggevuran illain dekudesha berich hu, vaamalek la hava dachil, hada hu dichtiv, velo yare elohim. la dachil lemikrav legabbach. veal da reshit goyim.

(Amalek have kadmaa) deatu leaggacha kerava beyisrael amalek hava. uvegine kach veacharito ade oved, dichtiv ki macho emche et zecher amalek. uchetiv, (Devarim 25:19) timche et zecher amalek, hada hu dichtiv veacharito ade oved. ade avdo mibbae leh. ella ad deyete kudesha berich hu veyovad leh, (kelomar ad dekudesha berich hu yehe oved leh) dichtiv ki macho emche vegomer. amar Rabbi elazar, ta chaze, af al gav dehatztzur tamim poolo, veavid immehon chesed leappaka lon mayya, la shavak dideh, deha ketiv vayyavo amalek.

Rabbi abba patach veamar, (Kohelet Adonai:12) yesh raa chola raiti tachat hashshamesh. kamma bene nasha atimin libba, begin dela mishtaddele beorayyta. yesh raa chola, vechi yesh raa dehi chola, veyesh raa delav hi chola. ella vadday yesh raa chola, detanenan, missitra dismala, nafke kamma gardini nimmusin, devakan baavira.

Vechad bayayn lemefak, azlin veishtaavin benukeva dithoma rabba, levatar nafkin umitchabberan kachada, uvekain avirin, veshatin bealma, umitkarvin legabbayyhu divne nasha, vechol chad ikre raa, kema deat amer (Tehillim 91:10) lo teunne elecha raa. may lo teunne. begin deatya betaskufa al beni nasha.

Chola amay hi chola. kad sharya hay al bene nasha, avid lon kamtzanin mimmamonehon, atyayn gabbay tzedaka gabbeh, hi machat bideh. amar leh lo tippuk middidach. atyayn miskene, hi machat bideh. ate hu lemechal mimmamoneh, machat bideh, begin lenatra leh leochora. umin yoma desharya aleh devar nash, hi chola, kehay shachiv mera dela achil vela shete. veal da hi raa chola.

Ushelomo malka tzavavch bechachmeta veamar, (Kohelet 6:2) ish asher yitten lo haelohim osher unechasim vechavod vegomer. hay kera, lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh, ketiv ish asher yitten lo haelohim osher unechasim vechavod vegomer, may velo yashlitennu haelohim leechol mimmennu. i hachi, lav birshuteh hu debar nash.

Ella, i ketiv velo yaazvenu haelohim leechol mimmennu, havena amar hachi. ella velo yashlitennu, divgin dehu hemneh lehahi raa, veachid bah. kudesha berich hu la shalteh aleh, leitbaraa techoteh, al dehu itree bah, veachid bah.
Vechol archoy kishchiv mera, dela achil vela shete, vela kariv lemamoneh, vela appik minneh, venatir leh ad dehu yippuk mealma, veyete achara, veyittol leh, dehu bealav.

Ushelomo malka tzavavch veamar, (Kohelet Adonai:12) osher shamur livalav leraato. man bealav. da achara deyarit leh. velamma zacha hay achara lemeheve bealav dehahu utra. begin dehay hemin lehahi raa, veitterae ba (hada hu dichtiv leraato bishvil hahu 270) veitdabbak ba. begin kach, hay achara dela itdabbak behahi raa, zacha (hay) lemeheve bealav dehahu utra hada hu dichtiv leraato, kelomar begin raato dehava mitdavak bah, ravavch leh hay.
Davar acher yesh raa chola, hay man deyativ bechulaka tava, bevet avoy, vehu azil lokovel avoy,
628: Betaskufe millin, ha itdevak behahu raa chola, kevar nash shachiv mera dechol archoy betaskufa, da beena, veda la beena, uvegin hay utera itdabbak bar nash beraa chola, veitanash behay alma, uvealma deate, veda hu osher shamur livalav leraato.

Kacha yisrael, kudesha berich hu natil lon al gadpe nishrin, aschar lon baanani yekara, shechinteh natil kamayyhu, nachat lon mana lemechal, appik lon mayyay metukin, veinnun havo azlin immeh betaskufin. miyyad vayyavo amalek.

(Shemot 17:8) vayyavo amalek, amar ribbi shimon, raza dechachmeta hacha, miggizrat dina kashya, ka atya kerava da. ukerava da ishtechach leella vetatta. velet lach milla beorayyta, dela it bah razin illain dechachmeta, demitkashsherin bishma kaddisha. kivyachol, amar kudesha berich hu, kad yisrael innun zakkain letatta, itgabbar chela dili al kolla. vechad la ishtechachu zakkain, kivyachol, mattishin chela dilella, veitgabbar chela dedina kashya.

Ta chaze, beshaata dechavu yisrael letatta, ma ketiv, vayyavo amalek vayyillachem im yisrael, ata lekatrega dina berachame. decholla ishtechach leella vetatta. birfidim: berafuy yadayim, derafu yedehon meorayyta dekudesha berich hu, kema deokimna. amar Rabbi yehuda, tere zimne aggach kerava amalek beyisrael, chad hacha. vechad dichtiv, (Bamidbar 14:45) vayyered haamaleke vehakkenaani vegomer.

Amar Rabbi shimon, leella vetatta. kitruga dekudesha berich hu hava, leella, kema deittemar. letatta bekudesha berich hu hava, dahavo nasbe legavre, vegazre lon arlata (sefer acher ata) dirshima kaddisha, venatle lehu vearmu lon leella, veamre tol lach ma deitreit. veal kol panim dekudesha berich hu hava (kol kavebalenaa kolla) (sefer acher kabbala) kolla.

(Shemot 17:9) vayyomer moshe el yehoshua bachar lanu anashim vetze hillachem baamalek. vechi ma chama moshe, desalik garmeh, mehay kerava kadmaa dekudesha berich hu pakid. ella moshe zakkaa chulakeh, deistakkal veyada ikara demilla. amar moshe, ana azmin garmi lehahu kerava dilella, veant yehoshua zammin garmach lekarva diltatta.
Vehayeynu dichtiv, vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael: yisrael dilella. uvegin kach salik moshe garmeh mikkerava diltatta, begin leizdarza bikrava dilella, veyitnetzach al yedoy.

Amar Rabbi shimon, vechi kalah hi beenecha, kerava da daamalek. ta chaze, min yoma deitbere alma, ad hahu zimna, umehahu zimna, ad deyete malka meshicha, vaafillu beyomoy degog umagog, la yishtekach kevavteh. lav begin chayyaylin takkifin vesaggiin, ella begin divchol sitrin dekudesha berich hu hava.

Vayyomer moshe al yehoshua, amay lihoshua, vela leochora, veha behahu zimna ravya hava, dichtiv, (Shemot 33:11) vihoshua bin nun naar, vechamma havo beyisrael takkifin minneh. ella moshe bechachmeta istakkal veyada. may chama. chama lesomol dehava nachit missitra dilella, lesayyeya laamalek letatta. amar moshe, vadday kerava hacha takkifa itchaziyi.

Yehoshua behahu zimna bedarga illaa yattir ishtechach. i tema divshechinta ishtechach behahu zimna lav hachi, deha bemoshe itnesivat veitachadat, ishtechach yehoshua deitachad letatta minnah. uvamme. amar Rabbi shimon, behahu atar, deitkere naar.

Vehayeynu deamar ribbi yehuda, may dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:20) enecha tirena yerushala 40 nav shaanan ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lanetzach. yerushala 40: yerushala 40 dilella, deikre ohel bal yitzan, dela yishtekach yattir lemehach begaluta, veda hu raza dichtiv, vihoshua bin nun naar. naar vadday. lo yamish mittoch haohel, hahu deikre ohel bal yitzan. melammed divchol yoma veyoma, hava yanik mishchinta, kema dehahu naar dilella, lo yamish mittoch haohel, veyanik minneh tadira. kach hay naar
629: Diltatta lo yamish mittoch haohel, veyanik minnah tadira.

Begin kach, kad chama moshe, lesomol, nachit lesayyeya laamalek, amar moshe, vadday hay naar yekum lokovleh, veyishshelot aleh, lenatztzecha leh. miyyad vayyomer moshe el yehoshua bachar lanu anashim vetze hillachem baamalek, dilach hay kerava diltatta, vaana izdarez likrava dilella. bachar lanu anashim, zakkain bene zakkain, deyitchazun lemehach immach.

Amar rabbi shimon, beshaata denafik yehoshua naar. ittear naar dilella, veittakkan bechamma tikkunin bechamma zayynin, deatkinat leh imeh, likrava da, lenakma nukema divrit. vehayeynu dichtiv, (Vayikra 26:25) cherev nokemet nekam berit, veda hu raza dichtiv, vayyachalosh yehoshua et amalek veet ammo lefi charev. lefi cherev vadday, vela lefum rumechin vezayynin, ella bacherev vadday hi, hay deikre cherev nokemet nekam berit.

Umoshe ittakkan likrava dilella, vide moshe kevedim: kevedim mammash, yakkirin, kaddishin, la istavan lealmin. yekirin deitchazun leaggacha behu kerava dilella. vayikchu even vayyasimu tachtav vayyeshev aleha, begin deyisrael sharyayn betzaara, vihe immehon betzaarehon.

Veaharon vechur tamchu veyadav mizze echad umizze echad vayhi yadav emuna vegomer, may tamchu veyadav. emuna. (emuna, mehemanuta veda) vechi al deaharon vechur temichu lidoy, havo yedoy emuna. ella, moshe kolla bechachmeta avid ma deavid. aharon vechur, da missitra dileh, veda missitra dileh, veyadoy beemtzaita, veal da vayhi yadav emuna, mehemanuta. aharon begin deyittear sitra dileh, (chavekat 131 amud bet) vechur begin deyittear sitra dileh, vahavu achidan bidoy mikkan umikkan, deishtachcha siua dilella.

(Shemot 17:11) vehaya kaasher yarim moshe yado vegavar yisrael. kaasher yarim: dezakif yemina al semala, veitkavvavn bifrishu deyadoy. vegavar yisrael: yisrael dilella. vechaasher yaniach yado vegavar amalek, beshaata deyisrael letatta, mishtakkechin mitztzelota, la yachlin yede moshe lemekam bizkifu, vegavar amalek. mikkan olifna, af al gav dechahana paris yedoy, bekarbena, letakkena garmeh becholla, yisrael bayayn leishtakkecha bitzlothon, immeh.

Tana, bikrava da daamalek, ishtechachu illain vetattain, veal da, vayhi yadav emuna, behemnuta kadka chaze. vayhi yadav emuna. vayyihyu yadav mibbae leh. ella, begin detalya kolla bimina, ketiv vayhi. uchetiv yadav, begin dehu ikara decholla. uchetiv, (shamevatetav) yemincha Adonai nedari bakkoach yemincha Adonai tiratz oyev.

(Shemot 17:14) vayyomer Adonai el moshe ketov zot zikkaron besefer vegomer. ta chaze, ma ketiv leella, vayyachalosh yehoshua et amalek veet ammo lefi charev. vayyachalosh, vayyaharog mibbae leh. ella, vayyachalosh, kema deittemar, (Yeshayahu 14:12) cholesh al goyim. yehoshua hava cholesh alayyhu, vehahu cherev nokemet nekam berit katil lon, dichtiv lefi charev kema deittemar.
Ketov zot zikkaron, zot dayka. vesim beazne yehoshua, deha hu zamin lekatla malchin acharanin. ki macho emche. macho: leella. emche: letatta. zecher, ducherana dilella vetatta.
Amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv ki macho emche, uchetiv (Devarim 25:19) timche et zecher amalek. ella, amar kudesha berich hu, attun machun ducheraneh letatta, vaana emche ducheraneh leella.

Amar ribbi yose, amalek ammin acharanin ayytin immeh, vechullehu dechilu lekarva behu beyisrael, bar ihu. uvegin kach, yehoshua hava cholesh alayyhu. ribbi yesa amar, vayyachalosh yehoshua, detavar chela dilhon milleella.

(Shemot 17:15) vayyiven moshe mizbeach vayyikra shemo Adonai nissi. vayyiven moshe mizbeach, lokovel hahu dilella. vayyikra shemo hahu moshe (nusach acher dehahu mizbeach) Adonai nissi. may Adonai nissi. begin deankim nikmata dehahu reshima
630: Kaddisha deyisrael, umehahu zimna itkere, cherev nokemet nekam berit.

Ribbi yose amar, vayyiven moshe mizbeach, mizbach lechappera alayyhu. vayyikra shemo. shemo deman. amar ribbi chiyyay shemeh demadbecha hahu. Adonai nissi: kema deat amer, vesham nissahu. vecholla milla chad, al deitperau yisrael, veitgalyay hahu at kayyayma, reshima kaddisha. mikkan olifna, dechevan deitgezar bereh devar nash, veitgalyay beh at reshima kaddisha kayyayma. hahu ikre mizbeach lechappera aleh. uma shemeh. Adonai nissi.
Kegavvna da yaakov, benah madbecha, dichtiv, (Bereshit 33:20) vayyatztzev sham mizbeach vayyikra lo el elohe yisrael. leman. lehahu atar deikre mizbeach. uman shemeh. el elohe yisrael.

Amar ribbi yose, may dichtiv, (Shemot 24:10) vayyiru et elohe yisrael vegomer. vechi man yachil lemechome leh lekudesha berich hu, veha ketiv (Shemot 33:20) ki lo yirani haadam vachay. vehacha amar vayyiru ella deitgalya keshet alayyhu bigvavnin nehirin, vehachi tanenan, kol man deistakkal bakkeshet, keman demistakkal bashshechina, uleistakkela bishchinta asir.

Veal da, asir leh leinish, leistakkela beetzbeayyhu dechahane, beshaata defarse yedayyhu. asur leistakkela bakkeshet. man keshet. amar ribbi abba, bakkeshet setam amar leh may bakkeshet setam amar leh bakkeshet dilella, uvakkeshet diltatta.

Bakkeshet dilella, bigvavnoy. dechol man deyistakkal bigvavnoy, keillu istakkal beatar dilella, veasir leistakkela beh, dela yaavid kelana bishchinta. keshet diltatta may hi. hahu at kayyayma, deitreshim beh bevar nash, dechol man deyistakkal beh, avid kelana leella.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, i hachi vehachtiv (Bereshit 24:2) sim na yadcha tachat yerechi, dehava ome leh behay at. amar leh, anach lehu laavahan dealma, delet innun kishar bene alma. veod, sim na yadcha tachat yerechi ketiv, vela ketiv ree tachat yerechi, begin kach asir leistakkela bakkeshet setam, kema detanenan.

Tana, vayyiru et elohe yisrael, deitgalya keshet alayyhu, bigvavnin shappirin nehirin, melahatan lechol ivar, mashma dichtiv, et elohe yisrael vela ketiv vayyiru elohe yisrael. amar ribbi yose, nehora devutzina dishchinta. umay nihu. hahu deikre naar, dimshammesh lishchinta, bemakdesha. uvegin kach, et dayyka.

Vetachat raglav kemaase livnat hassappir, deitreshim beh techot ducheteh, chad levenata meinnun levenin dahavo banin bemitzrayim, detanenan, itteta chada olidat bemitzrayim, vahava atin sarche paro, vealat leh bechad levenata, veata pas yeda veachid leh, veitreshim techot ragloy dishchinta, vekayyeyma kameh, ad deittokad be makdesha diltatta, dichtiv, (Eicha 2:1) velo zachar hadom raglav.

Rabbi chiyyay amar, livnat hassappir: nehiruta desappir, kaldite bekandite gelifin illain dilella, demitlahata leshivin uteren ivri, hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 54:11) visadtich bassappirim. (Shemot 24:10) ucheetzem hashshamayim. may etzem hashshamayim. amar ribbi abba, ma etzem hashshamayim, gelifa beshivin uteren anafin, parchin melahatan bechol ivar. uf hacha, chezu dehahu etzem hashshamayim kechezu shemayya mammash. ribbi yehuda amar, kolla itreshim behahu nehiru, dechezu demitgalfa missitra dishchinta.

Amar ribbi chizkiyya, i hachi, veha shittin innun, besacharanih dishchinta, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 3:7) shishshim gibborim saviv lah. amar leh hachi hu vadday. ella innun shittin, itnehiru bitresar techumin, vela adiu missacharanutaha lealmin. detanenan, teresar techumin, gelifin illain, bematkela seliku, beilana kaddisha rabba vetakkif. vechullehu nehirin bematronita, kad itchabberat bemalka. veda hu etzem hashshamayim, etzem hashshamayim mammash. vechol innun nehirin shevilin, menaharin beh, binhiru dematronita.
Vetana, nehiru deillen shittin, desacharanaha, reshimin beh behahu naar, vekarenan lehu shittin pulese denura, deitlabbash behu missetar dishchinta, mitlahatan bedina, hada hu dichtiv
631: Tana, vayyiven moshe mizbeach kema daamena. vayyikra shemo Adonai nissi. Adonai nissi mammash. amay. begin daamalek natal kol innun dahavo gezirin, vela itperau, vegazar lon veshade lehu leella, veamar tol ma deitreit beh. beh shaata ma ketiv. vayyomer ki yad al kes yah milchama laAdonai baamalek middor dor. middor dor chaserin, middiyyurin dilella, umiddiyyurin diltatta.

Amar ribbi yehuda, bechol dara vedara, bechol darin deatyayn lealma, let lach dar delet behu mehahu zara bisha, vkudesha berich hu agach behu kerava. (Rabbi yitzchak amar madeyrevatea diltatta ladeyveraa dilella) vealayyhu ketiv (Tehillim 104:35) yittammu chattaim min haaretz vegomer. min haaretz: bealma den, uvealma deate. beh zimna ketiv, barchi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah.
632: Uveha kol sitra dikdushsha itachad leella learama, keden kol sitrin acharanin itkafyayn kullehu, veodan lemalka kaddisha.

Ta chaze, beraza dikdushsha (nusach acher dishma kaddisha) ihu melech, vechohen umeshammesh techoteh, (beraza dikdushsha) ben leella ben letatta. it melech leella, deihu raza dekodesh hakkodashim, veihu melech illaa, utechoteh it kohen raza deor kadmaa, deka meshammesh kameh, veda ihu kohen deikre gadol, sitra dimina.

It melech letatta, deihu kegavvna dehahu melech illaa, veihu melech al kolla diltatta. utechoteh it kohen dimshammesh leh, raza demichael kahana rabba, deihu limina. (vadday besitra dikdushsha it melech vechohen) veda ihu raza dimhemanuta shelemata, sitra dikdushsha.

Besitra achara, delav ihu sitra dikdusha, it raza deihu melech, veha okimna deikre (Kohelet 4:13) melech zaken uchesil, utechoteh it kohen on, veda hu raza dichtiv, (Hoshea 12:9) vayyomer efrayim ach asharti matzati on li, begin dechela da, shalta al hahu ovada daavad yaravam. veilmale deashkach chela da, la yachil leatzlacha behahu ovada.

Raza demilla, beshaata dehay melech vehay kohen itkafyayn, veittebaru, keden kol sitrin acharanin itkafyayn, veodan leh lekudesha berich hu, keden kudesha berich hu shalit bilchodoy ella vetatta, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 2:11) venisgav Adonai levaddo bayyom hahu.

Kegavvna da, veraza da mammash, avad kudesha berich hu beara, detavar melech zaken uchesil, veda hu paro, beshaata deata moshe lefaro, veamar, (Shemot Adonai:3) elohe haivrim nikra alenu, patach veamar, lo yadati et Adonai, uvaa kudesha berich hu deyityakkar shemeh beara, kema deihu yakkira leella. kevan dealke leh uleammeh, ata veode leh lekudesha berich hu.

Ulevatar ittevar veitkafyay hahu kohen on, yitro, dimshammesh techoteh, ad deata veode leh lekudesha berich hu, veamar baruch Adonai asher hitztzil etchem vegomer, atta yadati ki gadol Adonai vegomer, veda hu kohen on, sitra achara, deihu setar semala. veda ihu raza deamra rachel, kad chamatt demitat, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit la) ben oni. uvegin da oche (nusach acher ode) yaakov, veamar ben yamin, vela ben oni, setar yemina, vela semala.

Vechevan dehahu melech vechohen odu lekudesha berich hu, veittebaru kameh, keden istelak kudesha berich hu bikareh al kolla, ella vetatta, vead deistallak kudesha berich hu bikareh, kad odan illen kameh, la ityeyhivat orayyta. ad levatar deata yitro, veode veamar, atta yadati ki gadol Adonai mikkol haelohim. baruch Adonai asher hitztzil etchem vegomer. keden istallak kudesha berich hu bikareh, ella vetatta, ulevatar yahav orayyta bishlimu, deshultanu al kolla.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 67:4) yoducha ammim elohim yoducha ammim kullam, ta chaze, david malka kam veshabbach veode lemalka kaddisha. vehu ishtaddal beorayyta, behahi shaata kad ruach tzafon ittear, vahava batash beinnun nimin dechinnora, vechinnora hava menaggen veamar shira vechulei, uma shira hava kaamar.

Ta chazi, beshaata dekudesha berich hu itar legabbe kol innun retichin, lemehav lon tarpa, kema deokimna dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. keden, kullehu bechedu, patche veamre, (Tehillim 67:2) elohim yechannenu vivarchenu yaer panav ittanu sela. kad ruach tzafon ittear venachit lealma, nashiv veamar, ladaat baaretz darkecha bechol goyim yeshuatecha. kinnor beshaata deihu menaggena beh behahu rucha, patach veamar yoducha ammim kullam (chaser) david kad hava kam, veittear aleh ruach kudsha, patach veamar, eretz natna yevulah yevarchenu elohim elohenu yevarchenu elohim vayyiru oto kol afse aretz. begin leamshacha tivu dekudesha berich hu, meella letatta. levatar ata david beruach kudsha, vesidder lon kachada, istakkal becholla hay kera dechinnora, (begin) dishlimu diykara dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta.
Beshaata dishar ammin itkafyayn, atyayn veodan leh lekudesha berich hu, kevan deinnun itkafyayn, veodan leh, keden ishtelim yekara dekudesha berich hu ella vetatta. beshaata deata moshe
633: Lefaro veamar leh Adonai elohe haivrim nikra alenu vegomer, patach ihu veamar lo yadati et Adonai.

Uvaa kudesha berich hu, deyityaykkar shemeh beara, kema deihu yakkira leella, kevan dealke leh uleammeh, ata veode leh lekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (Shemot 9) Adonai hatztzadik. ihu dehava malka kerofinos dechol alma, kevan deihu ode, kol shear malchin odun, dichtiv, (Shemot 15:15) az nivhalu allufe edom.

Ata yitro, komara illaa veravreva, rav memana (dechol memana) dechol taavavn acharanin, veode leh lekudesha berich hu, veamar atta yadati ki gadol Adonai mikkol haelohim, keden istallak veityeykar kudesha berich hu bikareh ella vetatta, ulevatar yahav orayyta bishlimu, deshultanu al kolla.

Amar rabbi shimon lera elazar bereh, al da ketiv, (Tehillim 67:4) yoducha ammim elohim yoducha ammim kullam. ata Rabbi elazar venashik yedoy. bacha Rabbi abba veamar, (Tehillim 103:13) kerachem av al banim. man yerachem al Rabbi elazar, uleashlema milloy, bar rechimu demor, zakkaa chulakana, dezachena lemishma millin illen kameh, dela nichsof behu lealma deate.

Amar rabbi abba, ha kohen on la ketiv beyitro, kohen midyan ketiv. amar leh, kolla ihu chad. bekadmita chamuy deyosef, kohen on ikre. ulevatar chamuy demoshe, kohen midyan. vecholla raza chada, deha illen teren moshe veyosef. bedarga deraza chada kayymin, beraza deat vav, teren vavin kachada. uma deittemar kohen midyan, raza da eshet midyanim. (moshe veyosef beraza chada kayyme, raza da 12 teren kachada)

Arim yedoy al resheh Rabbi abba uvacha, amar, nehiru deorayyta salleka hasheta ad rum rekia dechurseyay illaa, levatar deyistallak mor mealma, man yanhir nehiru deorayyta. vavy lealma deyishtear yatom minach. aval millin demor yitnehiru bealma ad deyete malka meshicha ucheden ketiv, (Yeshayahu 11:9) umala haaretz dea et Adonai vegomer.

Vayyishma yitro kohen vego, rabbi chiyyay amar, hay kera it leistakkela beh, bekadmita ketiv, et kol asher asa elohim lemoshe, ulevatar ketiv ki hotzi Adonai. ella raza da et kol asher asa elohim, da shema deagin al moshe veal yisrael, vela itade minnayyhu begaluta. ulevatar, shema illaa appik lon mimmitzrayim. deha shema kaddisha deappik lon, beraza deyovla hava.

Davar acher et kol asher asa elohim lemoshe, kad itreme lenahara, vechad sheziv leh mecharba defaro, uleyisrael ammo, dichtiv, (Shemot 2:24) vayyishma elohim et naakatam. uchetiv (Shemot 1:12) vechaasher yeannu oto ken yirbe vechen yifrotz.

Vayyishma yitro kohen midyan. rabbi yosi patach, (Tehillim 111:9) pedut shalach leammo tzivva leolam berito kadosh venora shemo. may shena, bechol shear kerae, divchullehu, teren tevin mealfa beta, uvehay kera, uvikra daavatreh, telat telat. ella, begin leashlema shit sitrin, behay alfa beta, hay lokovel telat purekanin deyisrael, bar purekana kadmaa. kera achara, lokovel tora neviim uchetuvim. vecholla talya behay chachma.

Pedut shalach leammo, kad parik kudesha berich hu leyisrael, miggaluta demitzrayim, veavid lon nissin ugevuran. tzivva leolam berito, kad ata yitro, vekabbil leh kudesha berich hu, vekariv leh lefulechaneh. umittamman, itkerivu kol innun giyyorin, techot gadpoy dishchinta, mittamman ulehala, kadosh venora shemo. deha keden itkaddash shemeh dekudesha berich hu, deha (missitra achara) yitkaddash shema kaddisha, kad ittevar, veitkafya sitra achara, kema dehava beyitro.
Vayyishma yitro vegomer, vechi yitro shama, vechol alma lo shamu, veha ketiv, (Shemot 15:14) shamu ammim yirgazun. ella, kol alma shamu, vela ittebaru, veihu shama veittebar,
634: Veitkafya mikkameh dekudesha berich hu, veitkerav ledachalteh.

Rabbi abba amar, bechamma atar tanenan, dekudesha berich hu, kol ma deavad leella vetatta kolla ihu keshot, veovada dikshot. velet lach milla bealma devae bar nash ledachya leh minneh, uleanhaga beh kelana, deha kullehu ovada dikshot innun, vecholla itzterich bealma.

Deha zimna chada, hava Rabbi elazar azil bearcha, vahava azil immeh Rabbi chizkiyya, chamu chad chivya, kam Rabbi chizkiyya lemikteleh. amar leh Rabbi elazar, shavik leh la tekatlineh. amar leh, veha milla bisha ihu, dekatil beni nasha. amar leh lera chizkiyya, veha ketiv (Kohelet 10:11) im yishshoch hannachash belo lachash. la nashich chivya levar nash, ad delachashin leh milleella, veamre leh zil katil leh liflanayya.

Ulezimnin kema deavid hay, hachi name sheziv levar nash, mimmillin acharanin, veal yedoy archish kudesha berich hu nisa livne nasha, vecholla bida dekudesha berich hu talya, vecholla ihu ovade yedoy, veitzterich alma lehu, vei lav deitztericha lon alma, la aved lon kudesha berich hu. veal da la bae bar nash leanhaga behu kelana bemille dealma. bemilloy uveovadoy dekudesha berich hu al achat kamma vechamma.

Patach veamar, (Bereshit 1:31) vayyar elohim et kol asher asa vehinni tov meod. vayyar elohim: da elohim chayyim. vayyar: deistakkal leanhara lon, uleashgacha lon. et kol asher asa kolla bichlala chada, ella vetatta. vehinne tov: da sitra dimina. meod: da sitra dismala, veha ukemuha, tov: da malach chayyim meod: da malach hammavet. vecholla raza chada. raza hu, leinun demistachle beraza dechachmeta.

Vayyar elohim et kol asher asa. bechol ovada divreshit, ketiv, vayyar elohim ki tov, vehacha vayyar elohim et kol asher asa. elohim letatta, shalit al tattae. elohim leella, shalit al illae. da ihu raza deelohim chayyim, (nusach acher davar achar kolla ihu elohim chayyim) deanhir veadlik kol innun butzinin illain vetattain, umittamman nafkin kol innun nehorin leanhara.

Tosefta bitmiru ditmirin, itreshim reshimu chad, dela itchaze vela itgalya. hahu reshimu, rashim vela rashim. mare desachletanu, ufikchin deayynin, la yachlin lemekam beh. ihu kiyyuma decholla. hahu reshimu ihu zeer, dela itchazya vela itgalya. kayyeyma biruta, lekayyeyma kolla. lenatla ma denatla, mimma delet beh reshimu, vela reuta, dela itchaze.

Hahu reshimu baa leachafaya garmeh, veavid leh legarmeh, leittammera beh, chad hechala. hahu hechala appik leh migarmeh, umatach leh bimtichu rav vesaggi lechol sitrin, okir leh bilvushe yekar, patach leh chamshin tarin.
Lego bego, ittammar veitgeniz hahu reshimu. kevan deitgeniz beh, veal begavveh, itmalya nehora. mehahu nehiru, navin nehorin, venitzotzin nafkin meinnun tarin, venaharin kolla.
Hahu hechala itchafyay beshit yerian. innun shit yerian, innun chamesh. lego bego innun yerian, kayyeyma chad yeria merukkama, behahu yeria itchafyay hahu hechala, minneh ashgach vechama lecholla.

Hay hechala ihu pekicha deayynin, dela nayim. ihu ashgach tadir leanhara letatta, miggo nehiru dehahu reshimu. hahu sachletanu, chachmeta temirta, reu dirutin (sefer acher bau dabeavetayn) have ganiz vetamir, vela itgalya, kayyeyma vela kayyeyma. berich hu mittemir ditmiru, berich hu lealam ulealme ad amen. (ad kan tosefta)

Ta chazi, yitro hu deyahav eta lemoshe, al tikkuna dedinin, hachi itzterich. veraza da deode leh lekudesha berich hu, vesidder kameh tikkuna dedinoy, leachazaa ma dichtiv, (Devarim 1:17) ki hammishpat lelohim hu, vela lesitra achara. vedinin leyisrael ityeyhivu, vela leachara, dichtiv, (Tehillim 147:19) chukkav umishpatav leyisrael. veta chaze, la yanhig bar nash kelana beachara, umilla dehedyota, milla
635: Ihu. deha bemoshe ketiv, vayyishma moshe lekol chotno vegomer.

Vayyishma yitro vegomer. patach veamar (Tehillim 18:50) al ken odcha baggoyim Adonai uleshimcha azammera. david malka amar da beruach kudsha, beshaata dechama, deha yekara dekudesha berich hu, la istelik bisliku vela ityaykra bealma, ella missitra dishar amin. vei tema, ha kudesha berich hu la ityaykar bealma, ella beginehon deyisrael. hachi hu vadday, deha yisrael innun have yesoda dishragga leanhara, aval kad shear ammin atan veodan leh, beshibuda diykara dekudesha berich hu, keden ittosaf yesoda dishragga, veittakkaf al kol ovadoy. bechibbura chada, veshalit kudesha berich hu bilchodoy ella vetatta.

Kegavvna da, kol alma, dechilu veemata nafal alayyhu mikkame kudesha berich hu. vechevan deata yitro, deihu komara illaa, dechol taavavn acharanin, keden ittakkaf veshalit yekara dekudesha berich hu al kolla.

Begin, dechol alma, kad shamu shema gevureteh dekudesha berich hu, zau. vechullehu havo mistakkelan beyitro, deihu chakkim verav memana dechol taavavn dealma, kevan dechamu, deihu ata ufalach leh lekudesha berich hu, veamar atta yadati ki gadol Adonai mikkol haelohim, keden kullehu itrachaku mippulechanehon, veyadu delet behu mammashu. keden ityaykar yekara dishma kaddisha dekudesha berich hu, bechol sitrin. veal da itreshim parsheta da beorayyta, vesheruta defarsheta hava beh beyitro.

Yitro chad mechakkimin defaro hava. telat chakkimin havo leh lefaro, chad yitro, vechad iyyov, vechad bilam. chad yitro: dela hava pulechana umemanna veshammasha vechochava deshalit al shuletaneh, dela hava yada pulechana deitchaze leh, vehahu shimmusha dileh. bilam, hava charsha bechol mini charashin ben beovada ben bemilla.

Iyyov hava dachil bidchilu, uvehahu dechilu hava ikara dileh, begin demilla dilella, ben dikdusha, ben desitra achara, la yachil bar nash leamshacha rucha dilella letatta ulemikrav gabbeh, ella bidchilu. vichavven libbeh ureuteh bidchilu uteviru delibba, ucheden yamshich letatta rucha dilella ureuta deitzterich.

Vei la yeshavve libbeh ureuteh bidchilu lehahu sitra, la yachil leitdabbeka beh reuteh, bar lehane tofse dekikin, vela bechullehu, begin deit behu shaltanin, deitzterich legabbayyhu, reuta delibba udechilu. kol shekken innun millin illain, deitzterich dechilu veemata ureuta yattir.

Yitro itzterich pulechaneh dehahu sitra tadir, ben bezimna deitzterich leh levar nash, ben bezimna dela itzterich leh, begin dehahu sitra yehe davik legabbeh, beshaata deitzterich leh. bilam itdabbak beinnun charashin, kema deittemar.

Iyyov bisgiu dehahu dechilu dileh ahdar bemitzrayim lemidchal mikkameh dekudesha berich hu, kad chama innun gevuran venissin, deavad kudesha berich hu bemitzrayim. yitro, la ahdar bechol da, ad denafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, vechol innun kishrin vetifsin dekashiru mitzrae, la havo kelum, venafku. ulevatar detava lon beyamma, keden tav, veahdar lefulechana dekudesha berich hu.

Bilam la tav, vela ahdar, detinnufa (nusach acher datepasea) desitra achara hava mitdavak beh, veim kol da istakkeluta demerachik hava mistakkel, bego hahu tinnufa (sefer acher tifsa) veitdabbekuta desitra achara. deha besitra achara it nehiru dakik chad, denahir sacharaneh, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:4) venoga lo saviv. veda istakkeluta zeer (veal da) hava mistakkel merachik, vela bechullehu millin.

Vechad hava mistakkel milla zeer mehahu nehiru, kevatar kotala hava, amar vela yada may kaamar. vahava mistakkel behahu nehiru bistimu deena, veitgalgal ena, vechaze bar nash nehora setima, vela chazi. veraza da (Bamidbar 24:3) shetum haayin, veukemuha shetum: setum, vecholla chad.
Deha let sitra achara, delet beh
636: Nehiru dakik zeer missitra dikdushsha, kegavvna derov chelmin, devisgiut tavna, it chad garina dechittin. bar illen tafse dekikin chatzifin, dechullehu mesaave yattir. uvehu hava bilam yodea.

Zakkaa chulakeh demoshe, deihu leella bechol kedushin illain, veistakkal, bema dela ityeyhiv reshu levar nash achara bealma leistakkela. uchema devilam hava chame nehiru zeer dakik kemibbatar kotala, miggo hahu sitra achara. uf hachi moshe, miggo nehiru illaa rav vesaggi, hava chame letatta kemibbatar kotala, chad chashocha dakik, deitchaze leh. velav bechol zimna, kema devilam la hava mistakkel hahu nehiru bechol zimna.

Zakkaa chulakeh demoshe nevia mehemana, ma ketiv beh, (Shemot 3:2) vayyera malach Adonai elav belabbat esh mittoch hassene. hassen vadday hava bego hahu kedusha veitdabbak beh. decholla itdabbak da beda, tahor vetame, let tahor ella miggo tame.

Veraza da, (Iyov 14:4) mi yitten tahor mittame. kelifa umocha da beda salleka. veda kelifa la yitade vela yittebar, ad zimna dikumun metin meafra, keden yittebar kelifa, unehiru yanhir bealma belo setimu miggo mocha. zakkain innun tzaddikayya bealma den uvealma deate.

Veet shene baneha, amar rabbi chiyyay, vechi banyha velo banav shel moshe. ella, begin deihi ishtaddelat avatrayyhu, bela balah, kara lon orayyta baneha, velo banav. amar ribbi yosi, af al gav divnoy demoshe havo. milla dikshot baneha vadday. Rabbi elazar amar, ha moshe hava mizdavvevg baatar achara kaddisha illaa, velav yekara dileh lemikre lon banav. hasheta af al gav divnoy havo, begin yekara dehahu atar deizdavvavg beh, kara lon baneha hacha, levatar kara lon banav may tama, begin dehahu shaata dematu, hava moshe memallel bishchinta. levatar deitperash venafak legabbe chamuy, keden ketiv (Shemot 18:5) vayyavo yitro choten moshe uvanav veishto vegomer.

Amar Rabbi shimon, elazar elazar, ana chamena befarsheta da, deat share milla kedka yeot, vesiyyuma lav hachi. vadday begin yekara dishchinta, izdavvevguta illaa deizdavvavg beh bemoshe, ketiv banyha. vei tema, veha ketiv vayyavo yitro choten moshe uvanav veishto el moshe. kolla ihu kelala chada. uvanav, banav deyitro, deha levatar deata moshe legabbeh, havo leh benin.

Vehachi hava beyaakov, dechevan deata legabbeh delavan, veshavve dioreh beh, havo leh benin. uf hacha moshe, kevan deshavve dioreh beyitro, havo leh leyitro benin vechol beteh ayyte immeh, lemeal lon techot gadpe dishchinta, veyitro amar lemoshe, ani chotencha yitro ba elecha veishtecha usheni baneha immah, ushene baneha ketiv, vela ketiv ushene banecha. (sefer acher vayyavo yitro chatan moshe uvanav) benin havo leh leyitro, dichtiv, (Shoftim 1:16) uveni keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim uvenoy shavak im moshe.

Vayyavo yitro choten moshe. patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 2:3) vehalchu ammim rabbim veamru lechu venaale el har Adonai vegomer. hay kera ukemuha bechamma atar. aval zeminin shear ammin lemehach ulechatteta raglayyhu, lemeal techot gadpe dishchinta. lechu venaale, kol taavavn dealma it lon yerida, vekudesha berich hu man deitdabbak beh, it beh aliyya.

El har Adonai, da avraham, dichtiv, (Bereshit 22:14) asher yeamer hayyom behar Adonai yerae, deha avraham kare leh har. ma har hefkera lechol man devae bealma, uf atar da kaddisha, hefkera lekabbela lechol man devae bealma. el bet, da yaakov, dekara lehay atar bayit, dichtiv, (Bereshit 28) en ze ki im bet elohim.
Davar acher, har uvayit, af al gav decholla chad darga,
637: Seliku leda min da, har, lishar ammin, kad atan leaala techot gadpoy. bayit, leyisrael, lemeheve immehon keitteta bevalah. bediyyura chad bechedvav, urevia alayyhu keimma al benin.

Ta chaze ma ketiv hacha beyitro vayyavo yitro choten moshe uvanav veishto el moshe vegomer kevan dichtiv el moshe ammay ketiv el hammidbar. ella ikara dechola lema dahava ate el hammidbar. uman ihu har haelohim deda ihu atar legayure leitgayyra veal da ketiv el moshe el hammidbar lemoshe legayyra lon uleaala lon techot gadfe shechinta el hammidbar havu atyayn deihu har haelohim lemebad nafshayyhu

Uvegin kach kayyeyma hahu atar, beraza dehar dechol man deate zache beh. veikre (Vayikra 168 amud alef) ger tzedek. veha okimna, ger, af al gav deitdabbak baatar da illaa kaddisha, kevan deshavak immeh vaavahtoy (veitdabbak bivrito), ger (tzedek) ikre, keman deshavve madoreh baatar dela yada mikkadmat dena.

Rabbi yitzchak verabbi yosi, havo yatve yoma chad velaan beorayyta bitverya. abar rabbi shimon, amar lon bemay askittu, amru leh, behay kera deolifna minneh demor, amar lon may ihu. amru leh, hay dichtiv, (Bereshit Adonai:1) ze sefer toldot adam beyom bero elohim adam bidmut elohim asa oto. veha ittemar, deachme kudesha berich hu leadam harishon, kol innun darin dahavo zeminin lemete lealma, vechol innun parnasin, vechol innun chakkimin, dahavo zeminin bechol dara vedara.

Veraza olifna, ze sefer. it sefer veit sefer. sefer leella, sefer letatta. sefer letatta ikre sefer hazzikkaron, sefer dehahu zikkaron, veda chad tzaddik, veikre ze. uvegin dela leafresha lon, deinnun tadir kachada beyichuda chada, ketiv, ze sefer teren dargin deinnun chad, kelala dechar venukeba.

Veda ihu kelala chada, dechol innun nishmatin veruchin defarchin bivne nasha, kelala dechol toldot, innun beraza toldot adam vadday. deha mehahu tzaddik dekaamar, parchin innun nishmatin betiuveta chada, veda ihu shakyu deginta deashke hahu nahar denafik meeden, dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. veda ihu raza deadam, dichtiv toldot adam.
Levatar beyom bero elohim adam, da adam diltatta, deha teren adam ketive behay

Raza derazin (Shemot 18:21) vatta techez mikkol haam. ze sefer toldot adam. da sefer meinnun sifrin, setimin vamikin, (nusach acher da sifra meinnun setimin vaamaykayn) amar Rabbi shimon, arimit yeday betztzallu leman devara alma, deaf al gav dibbehay kera galu kadmae setimin illain, it leistakkela uleayyna berazin desifra deadam kadmaa, demittamman itmashshecha sifra geniza deshlomo malka.
Ze: detalya beh kolla. ze: ilana dechayyi. ze: vela achara degalle. (may) ze: kema deat amer, (Shemot 12:2) hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim, ze nisan vela achara.

Ze sefer, leashgacha ulegallaa toldot adam, ilana degalle toldot adam. veavid ivin leappaka lealma. ze sefer, leminda chachmeta setima vaamika, deittemsar leadam kadmaa, bediyyukena divne nasha, chachmeta da itmesar lishlomo malka, vyarit lah vechatav besifreh.

Olifna, demoshe itkashe beda, ad deatat shechinta veolifat leh, vhi chamat uvarirat lechol innun guverin deitchazun befartztzufa, vetamman olif moshe chachmeta da, veayil begavvih, hada hu dichtiv vatta techeze mikkol haam. hahu dichtiv beh (Tehillim 102:28) vatta hu ushenotecha lo ytammu. (Nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam. (Tehillim 3:4) veatta Adonai magen baadi.

Veatta techez, vetistakkal beha. ant, vela achara, leminda uleistakkela beshitin ribbo. beshit sitrin it leistakkela. bediyyukenin divne nasha, uleminda chachmeta al bureyih. villen innun besara. beayynin. bechotama.
638: Kera, chad raza dilella, vechad raza diltatta, adam deihu raza dilella, ihu bignizu, deganiz kera, bidchar venukeba beraza chada, dichtiv ze sefer, da kelala dechar venukeba kachada. kevan deavdu toldot kachada, kara lon adam, dichtiv toldot adam.

Levatar deitgalyay milleta, miggo setimu illaa kadmaa dikra, bara adam letatta, dichtiv beyom bero elohim adam bidmut elohim asa oto. bidmut (sefer acher da ihu) deadam ihu kehay chezu deitchaze diyyukenin beh, veinnun diyyukenin la kayymin behahu chezu bediyyukena bekiyyuma, ella mitabberan minneh, uf hachi bidmut elohim.

Davar acher, bidmut elohim, diyyukena deshayyfin dechar venukeba, beraza (tehillim kalat) deachor vakedem. achor: beraza deshamor. vakedem: beraza dezachor. uveillen talyayn kol pikkude orayyta, shit mea utelesar pikkude orayyta, kelala decholla. vetanenan, achor leovada divrishit, vakedem leovada demerkava. vecholla da beda talya. bidmut elohim, behahu diyyukena mammash, veha okim leh mor.

Tu, ze sefer toldot adam: lediyyukenin, beraze dediyyukenin debar nash, leishtemoda beinnun toldot debar nash, diyyukena derazin debar nash, besara, bemitzcha, beayynin, beanpin. beshifvavn, uvesirtute yedin, uveudenin. beillen sheva bene nasha ishtemodan.
Besara. hay man desaareh kamit, vesalik leella al resheh, mareh dirgizu. libbeh kamit ketufesa, lav kashran ovadoy. beshutafu itrechak minneh.
Saara sheia yattir, vetale letatta, tav ihu leshutafu. urevavcha ishtechach beh. veihu bilchodoy lav hachi. mare derazin ihu beinnun razin illain. berazin zeirin la

Bikmitin demitztzecha, beillen keritztzin deal ayynin. mikkol haam, beayynin. bedukin deena, ubbikmitin ditchot ena. anshe chayil, lemekam chela divhu behechalin demalka. bitztzehivu deappin. beappin, bikmitu deappin. birshimu divhu bedikna. sone vatztza, beyadin, besirtute yedin, reshimin divhu. vechullehu shit sitrin remizin hacha, deitmesaru lemoshe, leistakkela uleminda chachmeta setimaa, vchachmeta da, yartan zakkae keshot kedka yeot, zokkaa chulakehon.

Ketiv (Iyov 10:11) or uvasar talbisheni vegomer, (77 amud alef) kegavvna da aved kudesha berich hu leella, dargin al dargin, illen al illen, setimin go setimin, vechayyaylin uretichin, illen al illen, hachi avid bechol innun, arkin vegidin, veillen innun garmin, vekayymin bekiyyuma dedargin illain, villen ikrun (Vayikra 170 amud alef) basar, dargin vshultanuta deketz kol basar, vechol innun deithanun mittenana devasar, derechin dekarbenin, vacharanin deshaltin babbasar. vella mikkullehu or, mashcha (daatapetavetaa derakia veihu or demashcha) dechafe al kolla.

Kegavvna deavad kudesha berich hu kochavim umazzalot dirkia, bemashcha leistakkela behu, veinnun otot hashshamayim, uleminda behu chachmeta. hachi aved kudesha berich hu bivni nasha, reshimin ukemitin behahu partztzufa deadam, keinnun kochavim umazzalot, leminda uleistakkela behu chachmeta sagya, uleitnahaga behu gufa.

Kema demitchallefe bemashcha chezu dirkia, dekochavayya umazzale, lefum ovadin dealma, hachi mitchallefin chezu dirshimin ukemitin bemashcha debar nash, lefum ovadoy mizzeman lizman. umillin illen la itmesaru ella lezakkae keshot, leminda ulealfa chachmeta sagya.

Ze sefer toldot adam, mizzeman lizman, lefum ovadoy deadam, hachi ityelidu, veitreshimu vitchallefu beh reshimin mizzeman lizman. deha bezimna derucha kudsha sharya begavvih, hachi avid toldot, veachze reshimin hahu ruach levar.

Uvezimna demitabbera vezaz minneh ruach kudsha, veatya ruach misava, vehahu ruach misava hu mechashkesha begavvih, vachze levar chezu yedian, ureshimin deishtemodan beh bikmitin bemashcha levar. veaf al gav
639: Kayyeyma behu. ovadoy kashran vela kashraan.

Vei tale letatta, vela sheia, libbeh la dachil, mareh dizdona ihu. kasif beovadin dechashran, veyaan kameh, vela avid. vechad ihu siv, ahdar lemehevi dachil veyaan ovadoy. vehane mille, bemille dealma. aval bemille dishmayya, yitzlach man deyikrav beh. la yitgallun leh razin illain, aval razin zeirin tav ihu lenatra lon, mimmilla zeera avid rav, umilloy ishtemau. veraza da zayin, beinnun atvavn deshiura demor.

Saara uchama yattir tzahiv, atzlach bechol ovadoy bemille dealma, uvassechora, uveddame lon. vatran ihu da atzlach lechodoy. man demitchabber bahadeh, la atzlach leyomin saggiin, ella atzlach miyyad, vehahi atzlachuta parcha minneh. veraza da deihu bichlala deat 7.

Saara uchama dela tzahiv, lezimnin atzlach, lezimnin la atzlach. da ihu leshutafu uleishtaddela bahadeh, tav lizman kariv, vela lizman rachik, deha lizman rachik yachashov machashavin. uvegin dela yitparshun minneh, have tav lizman kariv. da yitzlach beorayyta. i yishtaddal avatraha. veyitzlechun beh acharanin. let leh raza, lizman rachik. dachik libba ihu. yecheme besanoy. la yachlin leh sanoy, veihu dachik libba, veihu beraza deat 10, dela kayyeyma bichlala deat 7, ella 10 bilchodoy, beraza deatvavn dekikin.

Saara demarit, yitzlach beovadoy, verammaa ihu kafin beveteh. itchaze dachil chattaa levar, lav hachi lego. da ad la siv. i saareh marit, levatar desiv, ithappach mikkamma dehava bekadmita, hen letav hen levish.

Saara leishtemoda, vetalya. da kayyeyma beat 7, vitchabbar beh at tz. da al veappik 60.

I saara da talya vucham, uvemitztzecha telata sirtutin missitra dimina, uteren missemala, vela mitchabberan illen beillen. bistar yemina it telata reshimin dekikin, deavrin alayyhu. veinnun shevilin lemebar al innun sirtutin acharanin. uvistar semala chamesh, vechad minneh zeer bearkeh. da kayyeyma bego at 7 veat 90. keden tishkach keritztzin takkifin deal chore enoy, demitchabberan da beda.

Da ihu bar nash mareh derugeza, vela bivhilu, venayycha dileh beikkuva. chashiv begarmeh deihu chakkim. velav hachi. zakif resha leistakkela tadir. mare matztzuta levar. beveteh lav hachi. orayyta la chashiv leistakkela bah. millin divne nasha chashivin aleh kematul, vativ millin takkifin alayyhu.

Vei mitparshan keritztzin da min da, matu vela matu, keden tishkach bemitztzecha lesitra dimina, teren sirtutin ravrevin vchad zeera, uteren reshimin zeirin dealin benayyhu lefuteya. velistar semala teren, chad ravreva, vechad zeera, vechad reshimu zeer deal bechad vela mate letinyayna.

Da ihu mareh derugeza, lefum shaata itmele rugeza, ulefum shaata shachich rugezeh, umare ketata beveteh, vlav beruach nayycha. zimna chada bealma (nusach acher beyomoy) ativ tukefin livne nasha. istakkal letatta. mitztzecheh kamit berugezeh, vedami kechalba, umiyyad shachich veativ rechichin. da ihu bar nash, derucha dileh ureuta leishtaddela dileh, bischorata (Ezra 4:20) uminda velo vhalach uveishtaddeluteh, salik lemamona. deha itchallaf at 90 beat 60.
